data.jd_text:
**About ARADA** 




 ARADA is one of the UAE's leading master developers, dedicated to creating communities that inspire, enrich, and engage. Since its launch in 2017, ARADA has delivered award\-winning residential, retail, hospitality, education, and wellness destinations across the UAE. Driven by innovation, quality, and customer experience, ARADA is committed to building vibrant communities that enhance the lives of residents, visitors, and businesses alike.
 



 As we continue our growth journey, we are looking for an experienced and results\-driven
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to join our Development team in Dubai. This role is instrumental in delivering high\-profile mixed\-use, residential, hospitality, retail, and commercial developments, ensuring projects are executed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Senior Project Manager will lead the end\-to\-end execution of development projects from design development through procurement, construction, handover, and close\-out. Working closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and authorities, the successful candidate will ensure the successful delivery of projects aligned with ARADA's strategic objectives, quality expectations, and commercial goals.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Project Leadership
 


* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of assigned development projects.
* Manage projects through all development phases including design, authority approvals, procurement, construction, testing \& commissioning, handover, and defects liability period.
* Develop and maintain detailed project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
* Monitor project performance against agreed milestones and implement corrective actions where required.



 Design \& Development Management
 


* Coordinate with the Design Management team to ensure designs meet project objectives, regulatory requirements, cost targets, and construction feasibility.
* Review consultant deliverables to ensure quality, completeness, and alignment with project briefs.
* Drive value engineering initiatives while maintaining design intent and customer experience.



 Construction Management
 


* Oversee contractors, consultants, and project management consultants throughout project execution.
* Monitor construction progress, quality, health \& safety, and compliance with project specifications.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings to ensure timely issue resolution.
* Ensure projects achieve practical completion and handover in accordance with company standards.



 Commercial \& Financial Management
 


* Work closely with Commercial and Procurement teams to monitor project budgets and cost performance.
* Review variation orders, claims, payment applications, and commercial risks.
* Support contract administration and ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled.



 Stakeholder Management
 


* Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders across Development, Design, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Facilities Management.
* Coordinate with government authorities and utility providers to obtain required approvals and permits.
* Build strong relationships with consultants, contractors, and external partners.



 Risk \& Governance
 


* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with company governance, development processes, quality standards, and HSE requirements.
* Prepare executive reports and project updates for senior management.



 Continuous Improvement
 


* Drive lessons learned initiatives and implement best practices across projects.
* Promote innovation, sustainability, and efficient project delivery methodologies.
* Mentor and support junior project managers and engineers where required.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree or professional certifications (PMP, RICS, CIOB, PRINCE2\) would be an advantage.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum
 **10–15 years** 
 of experience in real estate development or project management.
* At least
 **5 years managing large\-scale mixed\-use, residential, hospitality, retail, or commercial developments in the UAE.**
* Previous experience working with a master developer or leading real estate developer is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the UAE development lifecycle, authority approvals, procurement, construction, and handover processes.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and construction practices.
* Experience managing consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent understanding of FIDIC contracts and contract administration.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Excel, and project reporting tools.
* Strong commercial awareness and financial management capabilities.
* Familiarity with UAE authority approval processes and local regulations.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Leadership and team management
* Strategic thinking
* Stakeholder management
* Project planning and execution
* Commercial acumen
* Negotiation and influencing skills
* Decision\-making under pressure

data.jd_text:
You have previously articulated a clear academic vision and taken full ownership of the results. Your leadership has been visible and direct, not confined to planning rooms. When it comes to the science of learning, your involvement has been substantive—you have created something tangible, produced measurable outcomes that validate the approach, and established the credibility to present that work publicly. If this describes your experience, 2 Hour Learning seeks its central figure in academic leadership.
   

  

 2 Hour Learning operates on a model in which students achieve learning gains at twice the typical rate within a two\-hour daily window. This is made possible through AI\-based tutoring, mastery\-oriented progression, and a significant redesign of traditional classroom structures. The outcomes have been robust. We now require a leader capable of aligning execution across varied school environments, elevating the standard of academic leadership, and representing a movement rooted in evidence\-based learning science to external audiences.
   

  

 This position is not centered on theoretical exploration. It is a leadership imperative. You will be accountable for academic strategy in its applied form, establish explicit performance standards, diagnose breakdowns in execution, and develop high\-performing teams to produce tangible results. You will convert our scientific underpinnings into operational rigor and advocate for this model on a global stage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Developing academic frameworks that convert learning science into actionable direction for curriculum design, student motivation systems, and application interfaces.
* Overseeing academic execution reviews with Heads of Academics to confirm that school teams maintain alignment, accountability, and performance.
* Integrating findings from data analysis, stakeholder interviews, and direct observation into comprehensive academic ecosystem evaluations that identify the most critical obstacles to accelerated learning and recommend concrete solutions.
* Ensuring strategic coherence through structured planning, continuous feedback mechanisms, and progress tracking focused on student learning objectives.
* Serving as the principal representative of 2 Hour Learning in high\-profile settings, including keynote presentations and meetings with Ministries of Education, to influence global perspectives on education.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Engaging in limited curriculum initiatives that do not produce broader systemic impact.
* Producing theoretical research disconnected from measurable student outcomes or operational implementation.
* Transferring responsibility for performance management to mid\-level staff or external advisors.
* Depending on institutional prestige or conceptual arguments to convince resistant audiences.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and refine 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by coordinating execution across multiple schools, raising leadership performance standards, and serving as the authoritative public advocate for a movement founded on rigorous scientific principles and demonstrated outcomes.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D) in Learning Science, Educational Psychology, Instructional Design, or a related field
* At least 7 years in academic or EdTech leadership roles, leading a team of staff/employees (not an informal peer leader role, such as grade\-level lead); you must have been responsible for hiring, monitoring performance, coaching, and making termination decisions
* Experience driving learning outcomes for students and upholding student performance standards
* Experience applying AI or emerging technologies to improve education, such as through personalized learning, adaptive learning, AI agents, etc.
* Experience managing academic teams of 50\+ people (e.g., the teams you managed directly executed curriculum, instruction, or assessment)
* Experience interacting directly with students, teachers, or school leaders in a professional setting


**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
   

  

**With students consistently ranking in the top 1\-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6\.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
 They offer a dynamic, on\-campus and remote\-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
   

  

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

 RIKAS Hospitality Group is a Dubai\-born collection of award\-winning restaurants, cafés, beach clubs, and lifestyle destinations. Renowned for its innovative concepts, exceptional service, and commitment to hospitality excellence, RIKAS creates memorable experiences across some of the region’s most celebrated dining venues. With a growing portfolio and ambitious expansion plans, RIKAS offers exciting career opportunities for passionate hospitality professionals.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We are looking for an experienced and results driven
 **Operations Director** 
 to oversee the performance and success of multiple venues within our group. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, financial performance, team development, and exceptional guest experiences across all locations.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 



* Oversee the performance and operations of multiple venues, ensuring exceptional guest experiences and consistent service standards.
* Lead, coach, and support General Managers and leadership teams to achieve operational and financial objectives.
* Drive revenue growth, profitability, and overall business performance across all assigned venues.
* Monitor operational and financial results, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and maximize performance.
* Ensure company standards, policies, and brand expectations are consistently maintained across all locations.
* Collaborate with internal teams to support marketing initiatives, events, and business development opportunities.
* Foster a positive, high\-performing culture focused on accountability, teamwork, and employee development.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, legal, and operational requirements.
* Build strong relationships with guests, stakeholders, and teams while representing the company in a professional manner.
* Carry out any other duties required to support the success of the business.


- 


**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

* Proven experience managing multiple hospitality venues, restaurants, lifestyle venues, or luxury hospitality operations.

* Strong financial acumen with experience managing P\&L performance.
* Demonstrated success leading large operational teams through General Managers.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

 The successful candidate will combine exceptional client management skills with strong technical and commercial project delivery expertise and will play a key role in maintaining and growing long\-term client relationships across the region.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off meeting
* Ensure preparation of detailed project schedule with appropriate milestones, based on contract.
* Ensure that drawings are obtained from design team. Review and approve drawings prior to submission to client and monitor and review all rework and resubmissions until final approval is obtained.
* Work with Finance and Management team to prepare ACE and get it approved.
* Define initial organization of project team, competencies required based on contract and project scope and work with HR to hire members for key positions immediately. Define detailed org chart subsequently and take steps to build an effective team with required skill set and mobilize the team.
* Evaluate available sub\-contractor options and get quote from suitable ones and submit to management. Participate in a meeting with other committee members ( BU Head, regional head, finance head etc) to finalize sub\-contractor.
* Ensure resource mobilization for the project at various stages, as required.
* Ensure that soil testing and initial site assessments are completed properly as per schedule.
* Ensure that procurement is on track and provide necessary support for the same.
* Review and finalize Project Quality Manual (PQM) and Health and safety Manual ( HSM)
* Establish relationship with all stakeholders including the client and CE and internal stakeholders including management team, supporting teams.


**Project Execution And Completion**
* Ensure resource deployment and mobilization as per project strategy and project requirements.
* Ensure material procurement and logistics are on track and site is ready to receive materials as per delivery schedule.
* Set up efficient systems and processes to ensure smooth interactions between various departments.
* Monitor and keep abreast of all site activities and ensure that all issues and concerns are addressed in a timely manner.
* Monitor progress periodically against schedule, quality standards and budget (ACE), as well as against contractual requirements, client requirements and company standards. Highlight critical points and propose corrective action plans.
* Ensure adherence of every function and process to PQM and HSM right through the project lifecycle. Monitor NCR and keep a check on LTI.
* Prepare risk assessment and mitigation plans.
* Organize weekly project review meetings with project team, site team and Engineering team (Head Quarter) to understand the design progress, actual project progress in terms of SPI, CPI, EVM etc. and provide appropriate action plans.
* Present project status updates to the management team during management review meetings
* Gather extensive knowledge on local people and communities in order to arrange social awareness programs for site teams.


**Team Management**
* Provide guidance and support to the various project teams to achieve their respective goals.
* Ensure that all teams are communicating with each other appropriately.
* Conduct weekly review meetings with site team.
* Ensure that site team and workmen are motivated and engaged and ensure that all their basic needs are met.
* Ensure that new joiners are inducted and on\-boarded effectively.


**Client/Consultant Management**
* Establish a good working relationship with the client and CE and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Represent the company’s interests while dealing with the client/CE.
* Ensure that progress reports are shared with client/CE as per agreed terms.
* Keep the client informed of any changes/developments/major deviations from contract required during execution and get required approvals.
* Ensure that all client approvals are obtained appropriately and without delay and all client/CE inspections are conducted as per contract. Address any variations contractually.
* Approve all communications to the client, from members of the project team.
* Attend review meetings, along with project \& execution team as required when arranged by client or CE.


**Sub\-contractor Management**
* Ensure mobilization of sub\-contractor’s resources as per project plan
* Ensure development and implementation of sub\-contractor’s work plan and reporting/review mechanism.
* Monitor quality and safety plan implementation by sub\-cotractors


**Reporting**
* Review periodic reports submitted by heads of departments and take necessary actions.
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality, Schedule and Cost related items to BU Head/ Head of operations(SS/TL) as per mutually agreed terms
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality and Schedule related items to Client/CE as per contract.


**Financial**
* Prepare and periodically review project related budgets.
* Monitor and control cost to ensure profitability of project is maintained.
* Ensure that sales targets are achieved and invoicing and collections are done on time.
* Develop strategy for Processing Claims and implement it with all relevant stakeholders including customers, suppliers, partners, insurances and other third parties.


**Statutory**
* Manage contracts effectively with internal and external stakeholders, CE and client.
* Ensure that work adheres to all statutory requirements and policies on safety, environment and community issues as per contract, company policies and law of land.
* Be the front end for bidding for all local legislative and administrative government authorities.


**Role Requirements**
**Education :** 
 BE Electrical
   

  

**Experience**
 Electrical Substation projects:
   

  

* Should have 15 to 20 years’ experience in Electrical/Civil/Mechanical aspects of SS Projects Experience in the project management of medium / large size EPC projects.

data.raw_snippet:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective
data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Office Director to oversee and coordinate all aspects of the Office’s activities. This leadership role will focus on managing strategic partnerships, insights, and convenings while effectively managing a team. The Office Director will play a key role in strengthening communication and coordination among government and business leaders locally and internationally.
 



  





 The Office Director will ensure that strategic objectives are met by driving engagements, developing relationships, leading high\-level meetings, and fostering cross\-sectoral collaborations. This individual should possess deep expertise in managing partnerships, delivering insights, organizing convenings, and guiding team members to advance key initiatives.
 



  





**Primary Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Partnerships Leadership:** 



* Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders in government and business sectors locally and in priority global regions.
* Oversee the identification, engagement, and management of partnerships with multilateral organizations, international forums, and influential family and corporate entities.
* Act as the primary point of contact for partners, facilitating productive interactions and ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Collaborate with Embassies, diplomats, and government ministries to align partnership initiatives with Office goals and diplomatic missions.
* Drive the creation and management of a partnership database and maintain records of strategic engagements.



  





**2\. Insights Generation and Dissemination:** 



* Lead the design and execution of research projects, including studies, surveys, and workshops that inform strategy.
* Facilitate and manage regular insights sessions for senior businesses and governmental stakeholders on emerging geo\-economic and strategic issues.
* Oversee the development of high\-quality reports, briefings, and presentations that synthesize research findings into actionable insights.
* Guide content development in collaboration with team members to ensure alignment with Office objectives.
* Coordinate closely with the Communications Manager to ensure effective dissemination of insights through appropriate channels.



  





**3\. Convenings Management:** 



* Oversee the planning and execution of high\-level convenings, such as roundtables, conferences, and multi\-stakeholder meetings locally and key international locations.
* Ensure seamless coordination of event logistics, including venue selection, participant engagement, and on\-site management.
* Work collaboratively with team members to develop event agendas, speaker briefings, and session formats that align with strategic themes.
* Maintain a comprehensive annual convening strategy and identify opportunities to enhance or expand convening activities.
* Direct the collection and analysis of event feedback and post\-event reporting to guide continuous improvements.



  





**4\. Communication and Coordination with the Communications Manager:** 



* Establish and maintain open channels of communication with the Communications Manager to align messaging strategies with key objectives.
* Coordinate on the development of high\-quality content for various platforms, ensuring consistency and alignment with strategic themes.
* Work collaboratively on media relations, press releases, and social media campaigns to enhance visibility.
* Guide the Communications Manager in crafting strategic communication plans for key events and projects.



  





**5\. Coordination with the Office Manager:** 



* Regularly engage with the Office Manager to oversee day\-to\-day administrative activities and ensure smooth operations.
* Collaborate on project timelines, office logistics, and team schedules to ensure alignment with priorities.
* Review and approve budget tracking, expense reports, and procurement activities managed by the Office Manager.
* Ensure that HR processes, onboarding, and team member support initiatives are aligned with the Office's overall strategy.



  





**6\. Reporting and Accountability Activities:** 



* Lead the development of comprehensive reports and updates, summarizing the progress of strategic projects and partnerships.
* Implement standardized reporting practices for all functions within the Office to maintain accountability and transparency.
* Oversee the preparation of policy briefings and reports for key stakeholders.
* Ensure timely submission of reports to senior leadership, facilitating informed decision\-making and strategic planning.



  





**7\. Supervisory Responsibilities:** 



* Mentor and provide performance oversight for the Office Staff team members.
* Foster a collaborative environment that encourages proactive problem\-solving and innovation.
* Oversee team collaboration and ensure team members have the resources and guidance needed to achieve key objectives.



  





**Essential Professional Experience / Skills** 




 This role requires a dynamic, strategic thinker with exceptional interpersonal skills and a deep understanding of the interplay between government and business. The ideal candidate will be adept at navigating complex stakeholder landscapes and passionate about fostering collaborations that advance the Office's interests on the global stage.
 


* Minimum of 10 years of experience in senior management roles involving partnerships, strategic insights, and event convenings, ideally in government or diplomatic settings.
* Proven track record of developing and sustaining high\-level partnerships across business and governmental sectors.
* Strong understanding of the global landscape of business and diplomacy, with experience in strategic research and insights generation.
* Exceptional communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills with a diplomatic approach.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to oversee multiple large\-scale projects simultaneously.
* Fluency in English; Arabic language skills are highly desirable.
* Experience in leading and managing diverse, multicultural teams.

data.jd_text:
**Posted on the Senna Private Equity Careers Network.**
**Overview**
 This Senior Project Manager role is based in Dubai, UAE, and sits within the project management function of a real estate company. The position carries direct accountability for the end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-disciplined real estate projects on behalf of clients, spanning planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout. The successful candidate will lead experienced project teams, manage complex stakeholder relationships, and ensure that budget, schedule, quality, and risk objectives are met across each engagement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage all facets of project management — budget, schedule, procurement, quality, and risk — across individual real estate projects from inception through closeout.
* Interface directly with clients to define project requirements; prepare scope of work, resource plans, cost estimates, budgets, cash flow projections, work plan schedules, milestones, quality controls, and risk registers.
* Read, interpret, and apply standards to complex project documents including contracts, agreements, leases, work letters, project charters, surveys, and architectural drawings.
* Identify and qualify project delivery resources; conduct requests for proposals, lead bid analysis, facilitate evaluation interviews, and recommend appointments to clients.
* Lead and provide direction to multi\-disciplined project delivery teams, guiding them toward defined project goals.
* Implement and maintain a structured communication plan, including regular meetings, written reports, and meeting minutes, to keep clients and project teams consistently informed.
* Ensure project documentation governance aligns with company and client requirements; maintain data integrity, accuracy, and timely coordination of all project records.
* Track project progress against approved goals, budgets, and timelines; report on status and variances; develop and execute action plans to address deviations.
* Manage change control processes — assess change requests, evaluate impacts on scope, budget, schedule, quality, and risk, secure client approvals, and issue change orders accordingly.
* Identify complex project risks, lead constructability reviews, and develop and implement risk mitigation and contingency plans.
* Apply understanding of business context — including business cases, economic implications, and risk — to project management decisions.
* Analyse inputs from the wider team and make recommendations with direct impact on project and business outcomes.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree (BA, BS, BEng, or BArch) in a technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Minimum of five years of directly relevant experience in the UAE.
* Demonstrated prior experience managing multi\-disciplined project teams in a similar senior role.
* PMP certification is required.
* MRICS designation is preferred.
* Full professional fluency in English, both written and verbal; Arabic or additional languages are advantageous.
* Valid UAE driver's licence.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings.
* Working knowledge of MS Project, lease structures, construction contracts, and construction practices.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills; ability to solve complex problems and evaluate multiple options in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to comprehend, analyse, and interpret complex business and contractual documents.
* In\-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles; ability to forecast, prepare, and manage budgets and conduct financial analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce reports and deliver persuasive presentations to senior stakeholders and client groups.
* Proven ability to motivate, influence, and negotiate effectively with key team members, senior management, and clients.


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

* Direct client\-facing accountability on complex, high\-value real estate projects across the UAE market.
* Opportunity to lead experienced, multi\-disciplined teams on projects spanning the full real estate lifecycle.
* A full\-time, permanent position within a structured and established real estate company operating in one of the world's most active real estate markets.


 Application Process
   

  

 This role was posted on 22 June 2026 with Job ID 282466\. Interested candidates should ensure they meet the mandatory PMP certification requirement and the minimum five years of UAE\-based experience before applying. Applications should be submitted through the relevant posting channel associated with this reference.
   

  

**About Senna**
 Senna is a careers platform for professionals pursuing opportunities in private equity. The platform brings together relevant roles, market context, and hiring signals to help candidates navigate the market with greater clarity. For more information, visit joinsenna.com.

 End\-to\-End Hub Operations

 Operating Model \& Organisation Design
 



  





 \* Lead make\-or\-buy decisions (3PL vs in\-house vs hybrid), prepare and defend operational budgets and headcount plans, and implement the selected model.
 



  





 Process Design \& Continuous Improvement
 



  





 \* Design, implement, and optimize operational processes.
 



 \* Introduce KPI systems and performance reviews.
 



 \* Lead or support WMS/TMS implementation.
 



  





 Quality \& Loss Management
 



  





 \* Ensure compliance with quality standards across categories.

 People Leadership
 



  





 \* Build and lead the hub team.
 



 \* Define structure, plan shifts, oversee onboarding and training, and foster a culture of ownership and safety.
 



  





 Cost \& Budget Ownership
 



  





 \* Manage OPEX (labour, energy, packaging, outsourced services, maintenance).
 



 \* Drive cost\-per\-ton efficiency while maintaining product integrity.
 



  





 Supplier \& 3PL Management
 



  





 \* Select and manage outsourced labour providers, 3PL partners, maintenance teams, and service providers under clear SLA/KPI frameworks.

This role will require strong leadership, technical acumen and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.

* Strategy Development: Develop and execute a comprehensive automation strategy aligned with Amazon's overall goals, focusing on AWS Solutions. This includes identifying key areas for prioritizing projects and defining measurable success metrics.

Identify and recommend the best AWS services to meet our specific needs.
* Solution Design: Collaborate with engineering, operations and other stakeholders to design and develop innovative automation solutions. This includes defining functional requirements, developing technical specifications and overseeing the integration of new systems within the AWS ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization. Communicate project updates effectively and ensure alignment on goals and objectives.
* Team Leadership: Mentor and develop automation capability. Provide guidance, support, and opportunities for growth, fostering expertise in AWS and SCOT technologies.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor the performance of implemented solutions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Implement changes to optimize efficiency and effectiveness, leveraging analytics tools.
* Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external stakeholders, particularly those specializing in AWS integrations. Negotiate contracts and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.

* Excellent project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines, budgets, and resources.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.

**Job Description**
 Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
   

  

 The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.

data.jd_text:
**Summary** 




 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Family Firms Programme. This role will build Pearl Initiative’s thought leadership and impact in strengthening and enabling the family businesses sector, including supporting next\-generation leaders, in the GCC Region. Programming will especially focus on building the long\-term success and resilience of family enterprises by advancing corporate governance, ethical, strategic, and accountable decision\-making; transparency and disclosure; and innovation. They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 



* Lead the design, development, and execution of the Governance in Family Firms programme, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and strategic objectives.
* Continuously innovate and enhance the programme offering, identifying opportunities for improvement and greater impact in family firm governance.
* Develop and implement programme strategies that address emerging trends and challenges faced by family businesses, ensuring relevance and long\-term sustainability.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts, external consultants, and partners to co\-create high\-quality programme content and deliverables.
* Identify synergies between the programme and other organisational initiatives to drive greater impact across multiple sectors.
* Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.



  





**Business development, community enablement, and financial sustainability** 



* Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders’ engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.
* Manage an annual market engagement calendar.
* Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.
* Explore and develop new revenue streams for the programme to diversify funding and enhance financial sustainability.
* Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
* Represent the organisation by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
* Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.
* Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 



* Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
* Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
* Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
* Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.
* Run projects and initiatives with careful cost control and resource allocation to support efforts to achieve financial sustainability with long\-term working capital.
* Proactively communicate project and initiative updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with timely reports on progress, challenges, and successes.



  





**Expertise development and thought leadership** 



* Identify, study, and learn from market needs and pain points through research and stakeholder engagement to identify strategic opportunities for impact and growth.
* Lead the development of market\-driven solutions by translating identified market needs and pain points into actionable programme initiatives.
* Curate and convene the programme’s working group, bringing in together working group members and special guests.
* Monitor the market’s offering, notable trends, and any disruptions to consistently strategically position the programme.
* Produce a consistent pipeline of high\-quality, original bi\-lingual content (e.g., op\-eds, articles, blog posts, white papers, research reports, and working group position papers) that showcases expertise and generates meaningful conversations within the industry.
* Build a strong online presence by actively engaging in priority social media channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, industry\-specific forums) to share content, participate in discussions, and network with other thought leaders.
* Cultivate relationships with journalists, analysts, and other industry influencers to amplify thought leadership and reach a wider audience.



  





  





**Team mentorship and development** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the programme team members, ensuring ongoing professional growth and skill development.
* Provide regular performance feedback and create growth opportunities for team members, including guidance on career development and training needs.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative work environment that encourages creativity, continuous learning, and innovation.
* Encourage cross\-team collaboration and facilitate professional development opportunities to enhance team effectiveness and cohesion.



  





**Impact measurement and reporting** 



* Co\-define quarterly and yearly key impact metrics and engagement KPIs for the programme, ensuring milestones are achievable and validated with feasibility assessments.
* Develop surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance based on impact strategy, methodology, and templates.
* Coordinate data collection of surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance.
* Analyze data of surveys and feedback forms to study and learn from achieved and non\-achieved programmatic impact and performance, based on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs identified in impact strategy.
* Develop an impact baseline assessment for the programme to measure progress towards meeting key market needs and addressing critical market gaps.
* Recommend and implement programmatic improvements, expansions, and other strategic directions from data and insights.
* Prepare impact reports and communicate findings on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs at key programme and project milestones.
* Curate, co\-author, and publish programme specific sections for the annual report.



  





**Tech\-enabled skills development** 



* Proficiently use tools and technology solutions to strengthen team productivity, project management, business development, and research through continuous learning and training.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme development, project management, impact management, storytelling and writing.
* Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme and related special topics.



  





**Qualifications and experience** 



* A master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Corporate Psychology, Business Conflict Management and / or the social sciences, or a related discipline, with proven expertise and strong analytical skills.
* Additional certifications in project management, corporate governance, negotiations, impact measurement, or family business studies are highly desirable.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience in managing, coordinating, and executing programmes, academic institutions, think tanks, research centers, member\-based networks/councils, or non\-profit organizations.
* Work experience with family businesses is highly desirable, with a deep understanding of governance and impact frameworks, regulatory compliance, succession planning, and sustainability practices.
* Demonstrated experience leading in business development, revenue generation, and / or fundraising for programmes, projects, and / or initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver programmes independently while managing and building relationships with multiple senior market stakeholders, partners, and vendors.
* Expertise in research, impact analysis, impact\-driven programme development, and curriculum design is highly desirable.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and a portfolio of published writings is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required.
* Fluency in Arabic is required.



  





**Personal attributes** 



* Self\-initiator and self\-learner
* Emotional and social intelligence
* Cultural awareness and etiquette
* Strategic and solutions\-driven
* Passionate about subject areas
* Hardworking and meticulous
* Natural leader and team manager
* Collaborative and adaptive
* Open and transparent communicator
* Purposeful and driven by impact
* Strong work ethic embodying good governance and integrity

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

****Job Description****
 The Senior Director, Visa Global Processor Partnerships, is responsible for executing business development strategies through partnership to grow our business and drive innovation adoption with processor partners located in Visa’s CEMEA Region (Central Europe, Middle East, and Africa). These clients are third party issuer processors (TPP\\’s).
   

  

 This person will work with CEMEA Processing Head in CEMEA region and provide operational support, strategic analysis, sales analysis and technical expertise. The result of these efforts will be increasing strategic value to the client, identifying new uses cases, and delivering Visa innovation across the ecosystem including processing (Issuer), program management, BIN sponsorship and core solutions.
   

  

 The Senior Director will also directly develop the portfolio of issuer processors and processing resellers in the CEMEA region.
   

  

 The role requires a deep understanding of the payments ecosystem, its players, and payment technologies. The Senior Director is required to say abreast of global payment trends and technologies that may affect client strategies.
   

  

 This position is full\-time and located in Dubai.
   

  

 As the Senior Director for Global Processor Partnerships, you will:
   

  

* Head the development and execution of all related sales activities with all Issuer processor in CEMEA region
* Work with product and processing teams to identify and prioritize the implementation of Visa solutions (tokenization, push payments, installments, digital issuance, risk and dispute solutions) for TPP integration and distribution.
* Identify and eliminate friction points that limit our ability to innovate and drive brand outcomes
* Oversee the development and management of the reporting of CEMEA Processing Partnership sales plans, including relevant metrics. Review KPI’s regularly with Processing Head to identify variances and work with the RPS team to address them.
* The person will be directly responsible for all issuer processor relationships and business development activities:
* Deliver on specific and aggressive processor account plans focused on Visa processing products and services, including traditional products, emerging digital solutions, white\-labeled services, and/or open platform extensions to processors

* Build and deepen relationships/partnerships with processor executives

data.jd_text:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and the cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Technical Program Manager/Scrum Master – Global Data Center Segment.** 
 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation
   

  

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Data Center Teams, or solution teams, ensuring consistent application of Scrum events, roles, and artifacts in alignment with Eaton’s Scrum framework.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, fostering transparency, focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.


 Impediment Removal \& Flow Optimization
   

  

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to escalate and resolve systemic issues impacting team flow and predictability.


 Product \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

* Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and alignment to Global Data Center Segment objectives, including safety, scalability, and reliability expectations.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and global stakeholders, enabling clear communication and shared understanding of delivery commitments.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility

* Contribute to broader Agile maturity and ways of working improvements across the Global Data Center organization, consistent with Eaton’s global operating model


**Qualifications**
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, with demonstrated ability to apply them pragmatically in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with the data center or IT industry at senior levels.
* Experience working with cross functional global teams, including engineering, compliance, and operations.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Department \| Psychology**
**American University of Sharjah**
 The Department of Psychology in the College of Arts and Sciences at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applications for the position of Head of Department. The department seeks a collaborative and visionary leader with a record of excellence in teaching, research and service, and a strong commitment to student success and faculty development.
   

  

**About The Department**
 The department offers a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and contributes significantly to the university’s general education curriculum. Faculty members are engaged in diverse areas of research, including mental health and well\-being; cognitive psychology and psycholinguistics; organizational psychology; and social, cultural and personality psychology. The department values multidisciplinary collaboration and emphasizes both scientific rigor and applied engagement with the community.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Applicants must meet the following minimum qualifications:
   

  

* PhD in Psychology or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum rank of Associate Professor (Professor preferred).
* A record of effective and inclusive academic leadership, including experience in personnel management and decision\-making.
* Evidence of excellence in teaching, research and service.
* Experience with program accreditation, curriculum development and faculty evaluation.
* Familiarity with North American models of higher education.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 In addition to the above, the college will give preference to candidates who demonstrate:
   

  

* Experience as a department chair, program director or equivalent academic leadership role.
* Success in developing and supporting undergraduate and/or graduate programs.
* Commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration within the college and across the university.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor faculty, support student engagement and foster research productivity.
* A clear vision for the future development of the department, consistent with the strategic goals of the college and university.


**Responsibilities**
 The Head of Department will:
   

  

* Provide strategic leadership and foster a collegial and inclusive departmental culture.
* Foster and promote the professional growth of faculty in teaching and research.
* Oversee curriculum planning, program assessment and accreditation.
* Represent and advocate for the department within the college and university.
* Recruit and retain high\-quality faculty and students.
* Engage in teaching and scholarship at the undergraduate and/or graduate level.
* Participate in university service and governance.


**Date of Commencement**
 The position begins mid\-August 2026\.
   

  

**Application Procedure**
 Applicants should apply online at \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01");" rel\="nofollow"\>https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cas/empapp/apply.php?p\=PSY\-DH\-26\-01\.
   

  

**Applicants Should Submit**
* A cover letter describing their research, teaching and administrative experience, and articulating their vision for how they can contribute to the department’s development and success.
* A current curriculum vitae.
* Names and contact information for three referees (references will be contacted only for shortlisted candidates).


*Additional materials may be requested from candidates advancing to later stages of the search.*
 Applications received by December 15, 2025, will receive full consideration; review will continue until the position is filled.
   

  

**About American University Of Sharjah**
 American University of Sharjah (AUS) is a comprehensive, independent, non\-profit, coeducational institution of higher education that promotes excellence in teaching, learning, research and creative work. AUS fosters a community that celebrates diversity and whose members are committed to the ideals of open intellectual inquiry, ethical behavior and civic responsibility.
   

  

 AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to approximately 6,000 students from over 100 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. Among the top 18 percent of ranked universities in the world (QS World University Rankings, 2026\), AUS is consistently among the top ten universities in the Arab region (QS Arab Region University Rankings, 2026\).
   

  

 AUS is located in the heart of Sharjah’s University City, adjacent to the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and just minutes from Sharjah International Airport and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The campus is situated in a vibrant and cosmopolitan area offering abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.aus.edu.

data.raw_snippet: The Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Is
data.jd_text:
The Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.

**About the Council** 





 The Sharjah Council for Higher Education and Scientific Research (SCHESR) is an advisory body established by Amiri Decree No. (14\) of 2025\. The Council aims to advance the higher education and scientific research ecosystem in the Emirate of Sharjah by promoting quality and excellence standards, fostering integration among higher education institutions, and supporting a research environment that drives innovation and sustainable development. The Council is committed to consolidate the position of the Emirate of Sharjah as a leading scientific hub in the fields of education and knowledge, and as an incubating environment for creativity that contributes to preparing generations capable of keeping pace with future demands.
 




  





**Job Description** 





 The Director of Strategic Planning and Institutional Excellence is responsible for leading and advancing the strategic planning and institutional excellence framework for the higher education sector in the Emirate of Sharjah. The role ensures the alignment of higher education institutions’ plans and initiatives with national development goals and the strategic priorities of the United Arab Emirates. The role oversees the development of academic programs and research capabilities, enhances institutional integration among relevant stakeholders, and advances the data and strategic indicators framework.
 





 Furthermore, the Director leads efforts to leverage advanced analytics and artificial intelligence technologies to support decision\-making, while monitoring institutional and academic performance alongside local and international rankings. This contributes to elevating the quality of education and scientific research outcomes, while strengthening the institutional leadership and competitiveness of higher education institutions across the Emirate of Sharjah.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 • Lead and develop strategic planning for the higher education sector in alignment with national priorities and the Emirate’s strategic directions.
 





 • Align the strategies of higher education institutions with the Council’s strategic objectives, enhancing coordination and integration among them.
 





 • Develop the academic program frameworks and foster leadership and innovation within higher education.
 





 • Support the growth and development of academic and research talent to elevate the overall quality of education and scientific research.
 





 • Oversee the management of institutional data and analytics, leveraging them to support policy formulation and decision\-making.
 





 • Monitor performance indicators and benchmark rankings to boost the competitiveness of higher education institutions.
 




  





**Qualifications** 





 • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Strategic Planning in Education, Higher Education Management, Policy and Leadership in Education or any related field.
 




  





**Experience Required** 





 • Minimum of 15 years of experience in strategic planning, higher education management, educational policy development, or a related field.
 




  





**Skills and Competencies** 





 • High leadership and management skills with the ability to lead and motivate teams to achieve strategic objectives.
 





 • Proven experience in strategic planning, policy formulation, and development initiatives within the higher education sector.
 





 • Ability to analyze institutional data and indicators to extract actionable recommendations that support decision\-making.
 





 • In\-depth knowledge of global trends and best practices in higher education and scientific research.
 





 • Advanced skills in project management and tracking the execution of strategic initiatives. strategic initiatives.
 





 • Ability to build partnerships and coordinate effectively with higher education institutions and relevant key stakeholders.
 





 • Strong skills in preparing studies, reports, executive presentations, and submitting recommendations to senior management.
 





 • Exceptional communication, presentation, and persuasion skills in both Arabic and English.
 





 • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and manage priorities effectively.
 





 • Proficiency in utilizing analytical tools, reporting systems, performance management frameworks, and strategic indicators.
 




  





**Location** 





 Emirate of Sharjah, UAE
