At Turner \& Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.
   

  

 Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide.
   

  

 Our team is dynamic, innovative and client\-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**The role**




 This role will lead the project, championing the evolving operation of the project office, to ensure all the required support services to enable the effective management of the project are implemented. This role will assure the overall integrity and coherence of the project execution, supporting the client and key stakeholders in their decision\-making to ensure that the delivery of the project is optimised.
   

  





 It is expected that the Project Director will have the gravitas to successfully influence at all levels across both internal and external stakeholders.
   

  





 The functional leads will report directly to the Project Director.
   

  





**Key responsibilities**



* Accountable for leading, coaching and developing the project team, ensuring that activities support delivery of the client’s strategic objectives and add value to the business.
* Accountable for ensuring that the client discharges its regulatory obligations in relation to the project to ensure that capital investments are delivered demonstrably efficiently and with appropriate consultation.
* Accountable for developing and deploying effective and consistent working practises and standards which support delivery of the project (e.g. Risk, Schedule, Cost, Quality), aligned to Turner \& Townsend Best Practice. Provide capability support including training, coaching and independent assurance.
* Accountable for the assurance and scrutiny of the project through the gateway process and ensuring that all investments have robust business cases, and that investments deliver demonstrable capital efficiency.
* Accountable for the baseline integrity and for the provision of relevant, timely and accurate management information to inform effective decision making for an optimised investment.
* Accountable for the effective and efficient deployment of resources across the project.



  

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 20\+ years' experience in project management
* Bachelor’s degree in architecture, engineering, construction management or a relevant field
* Recognised Project Management qualifications
* Professionally qualified or equivalent. Preferably strong Portfolio, Programme, Project and Risk Management skills or strategy/business planning strengths to ensure the integrity of the project.
* A strong and inspiring leader, able to create a clear vision for the future, build a strong high performing team, engaging and motivating others to follow and pursue that vision.
* Proven track record of planning and implementing major projects, with experience of delivering in an operational environment with complex stakeholders.
* Experienced in solution development (or design) of complex projects of all types, especially complex construction projects.
* An effective problem solver, with a track record of applying a challenging and analytical approach to complex issues and developing innovative yet pragmatic solutions.

Job description:
   

  

 Job Purpose
 
 Responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects on time, within scope, and to required quality standards. Coordinates with stakeholders, manages risks and changes, and ensures effective communication and reporting throughout the project lifecycle to achieve successful project outcomes.
 


 Key Accountability Areas
 
 Project Planning and Delivery:
 


* Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Define project scope, objectives, and success criteria.
* Coordinate project activities and resources.
* Monitor execution to ensure timely delivery of project outcomes.



 Stakeholder and Team Management:
 


* Engage and coordinate with project stakeholders.
* Facilitate communication among project teams and business owners.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and project requirements.
* Conduct project meetings and follow up on action items.



 Risk, Issue, and Change Management:
 


* Identify and assess project risks and issues.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Manage and review project change requests.
* Escalate critical risks, issues, and changes when required.



 Quality and Performance Monitoring:
 


* Monitor project performance against approved plans.
* Review deliverables against acceptance criteria.
* Ensure compliance with project standards and quality requirements.
* Track project KPIs and report progress to stakeholders.



 Governance, Reporting, and Vendor Coordination:
 


* Prepare project reports, dashboards, and status updates.
* Apply approved project management methodologies and templates.
* Support the preparation of scopes of work and project documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors and monitor contractual deliverables.


 Role Accountability
 
 HR Proficiency:
 


* Ability to recruit, recognize and cultivate high performers and expose them in order to create a robust second line of management.
* Ability to recognize low performers and guide them to improve or release them.
* Ability to treat subordinates equally without any discrimination.
* Assessment criteria of subordinates is performance that leads to planned results.
* Ensure availability of delegation of authority matrix to have sufficient delegations as per company policy.



 Responsibility:
 


* Must take full responsibility for his operation as per the job description and the required deliverables from this position, taking into consideration the general company guidelines.
* Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
* Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.



 Delivery:
 


* Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
* Making a Tangible Difference:
* Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations.



 Business Planning and Performance:
 


* Able to transform the corporate goals into business plans.
* Able to Plan, follow\-up and execute those plans, whether they are annual or development plans.
* Monitor the plan performance and initiate action to strengthen results and take the corrective action accordingly.
* Provide periodic work progress reports.
* Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve the optimum cost efficiency.



 Organizational Development:
 


* Develop the organizational structure according to the current requirements taking into consideration future and development plans.
* Ensure availability of job descriptions for all job roles and deployment.



 Business Process Improvements:
 


* Develop, coordinate well\-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible.
* Should be conversant and able to navigate through IT solutions especially those relevant to his job and business.
* Promote the automated systems and using them fully, to spread its culture.



 Quality:
 


* Quality is considered as alfanar’s prime competitive advantage as such, managers are expected to act accordingly.



 Adaptation:
 


* Adapt to new and alternative techniques, technologies, management structures, and business models.



 Health, Safety and Environment:
 


* Ensure a safe, secure, and legal work environment as per the standard regulations.


 Academic Qualification Bachelor Degree in Business Management or Any relevant fieldWork Experience 6 to 10 YearsTechnical / Functional Competencies Project ManagementProject CoordinationProject ControlProject CommunicationsProject Change Management
   

  

 Profile description:
   

  


 Alfanar is a Saudi company with an international presence, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of a wide variety of low, medium, and high voltage electrical products, in addition to its portfolio of conventional and renewable energy solutions, oil and gas, water treatment, infrastructure, technical services, and digital solutions.
 



  
 



 The hub of alfanar’s manufacturing operations is Medinet alfanar Alsinaiya, a 700,000 square\-meter complex located in Riyadh. The complex houses an array of ultra\-modern manufacturing facilities and laboratories equipped with state\-of\-the\-art technologies and staffed with highly skilled professionals.
 



  
 



 alfanar derives its success from its commitment to providing the highest quality standards to its customers, and the continuous development of its human capital, who alfanar considers its most valuable asset. With this in mind, alfanar promotes a proactive work environment where its employees are always valued, nurtured, and empowered to fuel their pride in being part of alfanar.
 



  
 



 For more information about alfanar, please visit alfanar.com

data.jd_text:
هدف الوظيفة
   

  

 يكون مدير إدارة المعايير والسياسات مسؤولاً عن ضمان مواءمة الهيئة مع أحدث المتطلبات التنظيمية، وقيادة وتطوير وتحديث وثائق الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام (بما في ذلك السياسات، والمتطلبات، والمعايير، وإجراءات العمل الموحدة، وغيرها)، وإعداد إطار ضوابط خط الدفاع الثاني، ومراجعة مجموعة ضوابط الهيئة المتعلقة بمخاطر الالتزام الأساسية مثل الرشوة والفساد، والتداول في السوق المالية بناءً على المعلومات الداخلية للشركات المدرجة، وغسل الأموال وتمويل الإرهاب، وتعارض المصالح، والتغييرات التنظيمية.
   

  

 الأدوار والمسؤوليات
   

  

* المشاركة في تطوير خطة عمل الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام وضمان التوافق مع استراتيجية الهيئة
* تطوير الخطة التشغيلية لإدارة سياسات وضوابط الحوكمة والالتزام ومواءمتها مع خطة عمل الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام، والخطة الاستراتيجية لوكالة الشؤون القانونية والالتزام.
* المشاركة في تطوير خطة عمل الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام وضمان التوافق مع استراتيجية الهيئة
* تطوير الخطة التشغيلية لإدارة سياسات وضوابط الحوكمة والالتزام ومواءمتها مع خطة عمل الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام، والخطة الاستراتيجية لوكالة الشؤون القانونية والالتزام.
* وضع إجراءات العمل الموحدة بما يتعلق بالمعايير والسياسات ، لتطبيقها في الهيئة
* تنفيذ الخطط وتزويد المدخلات اللازمة للتمكن من تحقيق أهداف إدارة المعايير والسياسات التي تدعم الأهداف الاستراتيجية الشاملة للهيئة
* مناقشة متطلبات الميزانية المالية مع الإدارة العليا وتزويد المدخلات المتعلقة بعمليات إعدادها
* ضمان الاستخدام الأمثل لميزانية إدارة سياسات وضوابط الحوكمة والالتزام وتقديم تقرير دقيق عن التقدّم
* التحقق من المبادرات، والتوصية بالمبادرات التي تؤدي إلى تحقيق نتائج إيجابية لإدارة المعايير والسياسات، وتخفف من حدة المخاطر المالية والتشغيلية والتنظيمية.
* وضع إجراءات العمل الموحدة لتحديد/متابعة الالتزامات الوطنية/الدولية الجديدة و/أو المعدلة الخاصة بالالتزام التنظيمي (ومن ذلك الأمور التشريعية والتعاقدية، وما يتعلق بالنظام العام، والأوامر السامية، والاتفاقيات المبرمة مع الجهات الدولية، والالتزامات العادلة، والقواعد والمعايير الإلزامية ذات الصلة بالقطاع، والسياسات والقواعد التنظيمية وغير ذلك) من أجل المحافظة على معرفة آخر المستجدات المتعلقة بالأنظمة و/أو اللوائح التنظيمية و/أو المتطلبات الوطنية و/أو الدولية لتطبيقها في هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك
* التنسيق مع وكالة التواصل المؤسسي والتوعية بشأن الأنظمة واللوائح والمتطلبات الجديدة/ المحدثة (الخارجية والداخلية) من خلال إحاطات الاجتماعات أو الخطابات أو المذكرات أو الرسائل الإلكترونية أو غير ذلك من الصيغ التي تهدف إلى رفع مستوى الوعي
* وضع إجراءات العمل الموحدة من أجل تقييم الأثر وتحديث السياسات/المعايير/الإجراءات ذات الصلة وتنفيذ واجبات الالتزام الجديدة أو المعدلة
* إجراء البحوث والمقارنات المعيارية لأفضل الممارسات (كل سنة على الأقل) بُغية تحسين الممارسات الحالية ذات الصلة بإطار/سياسة الالتزام في هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك لجميع السياسات والإجراءات الوظيفية الموحدة لإدارة الحوكمة والالتزام
* تولي مسؤولية مكتبة وثائق إدارة الحوكمة والالتزام ومراجعتها دوريًا (كل سنة على الأقل)، ومن ذلك ملاءمة أنواع الوثائق المشمولة واكتمالها وتصنيف الوثائق وضمان جودتها؛ حيثما ينطبق، تحديد الفجوات ومجالات التحسين مثل إعداد وثائق داخلية جديدة للإدارة العامة الحوكمة والالتزام أو مراجعة الوثائق الحالية (مثل السياسات والمعايير وإجراءات العمل الموحدة وغير ذلك) إلى جانب خطط العمل اللازمة
* إعداد إطار الضوابط الشامل للمخاطر التي تتولى مسؤوليتها الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام بصفتها خط الدفاع الثاني ومراجعته وتحديثه دوريًا
* تحديد متطلبات ضوابط الالتزام لخطي الدفاع الأول والثاني فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التي تقع ضمن إطار مخاطر الإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام
* وضع ضوابط خط الدفاع الثاني التي تتولى مسؤوليتها إدارة الحوكمة والالتزام وقياسها باستمرار وفق مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية المحددة
* تحديد إطار الضوابط الشامل وضمان مواءمته مع أفضل الممارسات
* قيادة عملية تطوير متطلبات ضوابط خطيّ الدفاع الأول والثاني المتعلقة بالالتزام
* قيادة التعاون المشترك بين الإدارات مع المسؤولين عن الضوابط لتمكين جمع وتوثيق ضوابط خطيّ الدفاع الأول والثاني
* ضمان أن مجموعة الضوابط شاملة ومحدثة، وتشمل جميع فئات الضوابط، والأوصاف، والأنواع، والجهات المسؤولة، وغيرها
* الإشراف على تنفيذ ضوابط خط الدفاع الثاني الخاصة بالإدارة العامة للحوكمة والالتزام

data.title: Capital Projects & Infrastructure Management Consultant - Riyadh
data.raw_snippet: At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dy
data.jd_text:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.
   

  

 Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,400 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40\+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!
   

  

 We are recruiting individuals to join the Capital Projects and Infrastructure (CP\&I) team in our Riyadh office.
   

  

**Working as part of the growing CP\&I team you will be responsible for providing advisory services and/ or delivery of capital projects and programmes. Typical engagements may see you deliver services in procurement and supply chain, commercial advisory, project controls, governance and business transformation. Engagements will require you to lead at every level, work with a team, and solve interesting and complex problems. Depending on the nature of each engagement, your responsibilities could include:**
* Working with Commercial and Procurement leaders to develop solutions to deliver capital projects and programmes
* Reviewing and optimising operating models, systems, processes, and ways of working
* Leveraging your expertise to identify cost transformation opportunities, and develop strategies to realise the benefits
* Managing the collection and analysis of client data to contribute to the development of recommended solutions.
* Managing relationships with client stakeholders, leveraging your expertise to secure buy\-in to strategies and influence outcomes.
* Plan and implement agreed strategies, ensuring targeted outcomes are achieved in the optimal way, in both a delivery and advisory capacity
* Being able to communicate complex issues clearly and effectively
* Contribute to the development of best\-in\-class methodologies, thought\-leadership and intellectual capital
* Taking part in the recruitment process of potential junior consultants


 Our collaborative and inclusive culture is what makes us stand out. At Efficio, colleagues with diverse backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints come together to identify innovative solutions for our clients – and so we’re looking for our new team members to bring strong communication, empathy, and relationship\-building skills to maintain this culture as we grow.
   

  

 We encourage our teams to proactively innovate and challenge the status\-quo, backed by strong analytical thinking and creative problem\-solving abilities alongside comfortable proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. We’re looking for team members who enjoy and have experience of digging into complex challenges at a leading management consultancy or in a relevant industry position.
   

  

 Strong opportunities for career growth are an important part of our offering; as such, we love seeing ambition and a proactive approach to shaping your career to your goals and interests.
   

  

 To meet client needs, we look for flexibility to travel; you can you let us know your preferences when applying.
   

  

 We’d love to hear about any additional skills or experiences you bring to the table. We’re particularly interested in:
   

  

* Experience delivering capital projects and programmes, ideally in commercial, procurement or project controls
* Consulting experience, demonstrating experience working with clients and build relationships
* Strong analytical capability and aptitude
* A strong academic background
* Fluency in Arabic is highly beneficial


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Ensure compliance with contractual terms, company policies, and regulatory requirements

**Requirements**

* Excellent leadership and team management capabilities

**Benefits**
 Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

data.jd_text:
At Ten our goal is simple, to become the most trusted service business in the world.  
 



 We are already the global market leader for lifestyle management and concierge services, providing services from a strong global office network with over one thousand employees.   We deliver our service through a combination of Ten's proprietary, unique technology\-enabled platform and the expertise of our highly trained lifestyle managers. Ten is growing quickly and has ambitious plans to innovate and to keep inspiring and to continue to improve the lives of millions of members.
 



 Will you help take us there?  
   





**The role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Head of Service Delivery** 
 to join us in Riyadh. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the operational success of the region, taking ownership of end to end service delivery, commercial performance, and member outcomes. Reporting to the Regional Director, you will lead high performing cross functional teams, drive service excellence, and foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and employee engagement.
 



 You will be responsible for executing global strategies at a regional level, ensuring alignment with standardised processes, policies, and performance expectations while adapting delivery to local market needs. The role combines strong operational leadership with a focus on financial performance, customer experience, and scalable growth.
   





 Key responsibilities:
 



**Leadership,  Strategy \& Operational Delivery** 



* Lead regional operational and commercial performance, delivering strong customer, financial, and employee outcomes.
* Translate global strategy into regional priorities and measurable objectives.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvement, efficiency, and effective risk management.
* Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to implement policies and support sustainable growth.



**People Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Build, develop, and inspire high\-performing teams through coaching and leadership development.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Develop leadership capability and succession pipelines for critical roles.
* Empower teams to deliver locally while aligning with global standards and strategy.



**Service Excellence \& Quality Assurance** 



* Deliver exceptional customer service, ensuring quality, consistency, and strong member experiences.
* Use data, insight, and feedback to drive continuous improvement and performance.
* Embed a culture of service excellence and quality across all teams.
* Proactively identify and address service risks to maintain high standards and outcomes.


**Requirements**

**Essential requirements:** 



* Proven success in a Head of / operational leadership role.
* Knowledge and expertise in the travel industry.
* Fluent in Arabic and English.
* Record of success in delivering commercial and operational results through cross\-functional leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships across functions and geographies / cultures.
* Financial and analytical skills; able to interpret performance data and translate into actionable plans.
* Ability to promote operational excellence and a high\-performance culture.
* Sales experience.
* Exceptional influencing and communication skills, both internally and externally.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with CRM or operational platforms.



**Preferred requirements:** 



* Previous management experience in a travel agency environment.
* Experience with ultra / high\-net\-worth travel, or concierge sectors, including the provision of B2B services to such industries.
* Experience of leading operational transformation or large\-scale efficiency programmes.
* Experience in embedding automation and process enhancements into workflows.
* Strong change leadership skills, with experience navigating complex transitions.



**Location:** 
 Riyadh \- Saudi Arabia (100% on site)
   

  




**Benefits**

**At Ten, employees are at the heart of everything.** 




 The company promotes a culture of recognition \- through regular performance reviews and the annual Extra Mile Awards for outstanding achievements. Employees are encouraged to incorporate their personal goals and interests into their careers and receive support on their development journey. 
   





**What Ten offers:** 



* Attractive compensation package: Competitive salary and the Ten Loyalty Rewards program.


* Vacation policy: Paid vacation plus one additional day for volunteer work.


* Sabbaticals: One month of paid leave every five years.


* Remote Working Holidays.


* Exclusive employee discounts: Access to exclusive travel and lifestyle offers, just like our premium clients.


* International clientele: Manage a high\-quality portfolio with excellent service.


* Dynamic work environment: Diverse tasks in an international team.


* Career opportunities: Development prospects in an agile, growing company.


* Inclusive company culture: Diversity and collaboration are highly valued.


**About Us**

 Ten Lifestyle Group is a global luxury concierge service and offers a unique opportunity to become part of a dynamic team in our travel department. Our clients and employees are at the center of everything we do. We support High\-Net\-Worth (HNW) and Ultra\-High\-Net\-Worth (UHNW) clients in organizing their leisure and luxury travel. 
 



 Our goal at Ten is simple: We want to become the world's most trusted service company. We deliver our service through a combination of our unique, technology\-enabled platform and the expertise of our highly qualified lifestyle managers. Ten is growing rapidly and has ambitious plans to continue innovating and improving the lives of our members. 
 



 As a certified B Corp, Ten Lifestyle Group is part of a global community of companies committed to making a positive impact on society and the environment. 
   





**Our Commitment to Diversity:** 




 We promote diverse perspectives, cultures, and experiences. Diversity is a core part of our company philosophy, and we are committed to an inclusive work environment. All aspects of our collaboration \- from hiring to promotion \- are based on performance, competence, commitment, and business needs. 
 



*Ten works exclusively with a selected list of preferred recruitment agencies. Please note that we are currently not accepting any additional agencies. Ten Group is not responsible for fees related to unsolicited applications.*

data.jd_text:
By Light Professional IT Services LLC readies warfighters and federal agencies with technology and systems engineered to connect, protect, and prepare individuals and teams for whatever comes next. Headquartered in McLean, VA, By Light supports defense, civilian, and commercial IT customers worldwide.
   

  

 Provides mission‑critical Communications and Information Technology Services (CITS) support to the U.S. Military Training Mission (USMTM) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, ensuring secure, reliable, and continuous NIPR/SIPR network operations across all functional areas. Contributes to the installation, administration, maintenance, and modernization of IT systems supporting USMTM J6 and mission partners, including helpdesk, network, server, cybersecurity, and project management activities. Operates within DoW, USARCENT, CENTCOM, and NETCOM standards to sustain enterprise connectivity, data integrity, and operational readiness. Each position under this contract plays a vital role in maintaining the confidentiality, availability, and integrity of USMTM’s communications infrastructure while delivering responsive, professional, and compliant technical services throughout the 12‑month period of performance.
   

  

* Serve as the on‑site lead for all contract operations under the USMTM CITS program, providing daily technical and administrative oversight across helpdesk, network, systems, and cybersecurity functions.
* Act as the primary interface with USMTM J6 leadership, ensuring alignment of contractor activities with mission priorities, operational schedules, and performance standards.
* Implement disciplined project governance, risk management, and quality assurance consistent with Department of War (DoW), USARCENT, CENTCOM, and NETCOM directives.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and milestones in coordination with the Contract Program Manager, tracking execution and reporting progress against deliverables.
* Provide leadership, direction, and technical guidance to all contractor personnel, ensuring adherence to configuration control, change management, and ITIL‑based service delivery processes.
* Coordinate with higher‑tier organizations (RCC‑SWA, NETCOM, CENTCOM) for escalated network, cybersecurity, and enterprise service issues.
* Oversee continuity of operations (COOP) planning, ensuring uninterrupted network and communications support during outages or emergencies.
* Maintain accountability for contract deliverables, personnel performance, and compliance with all PWS requirements, including reporting and documentation standards.
* Ensure all work centers meet or exceed Acceptable Quality Levels (AQLs) defined in the Performance Requirements Summary Table.
* Support transition‑in and transition‑out activities, ensuring seamless handover of responsibilities, assets, and documentation.
* Provide monthly operational and performance summaries to the Contract Program Manager, highlighting risks, corrective actions, and mission impacts.
* Foster a culture of professionalism, responsiveness, and mission focus among all contractor staff, ensuring effective collaboration with Government and mission partners.
* Education Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Certifications PMP or CompTIA Project\+, Security\+ CE, and ITIL v4 Foundation.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT operations, network administration, systems integration, or enterprise service delivery.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience supporting Department of War (DoW) or U.S. Government programs in deployed, overseas, or mission‑critical environments.
* Demonstrated experience managing daily IT operations across helpdesk, network, server, and cybersecurity functions in accordance with PWS requirements.
* Proven ability to develop project plans, manage schedules, track milestones, and oversee quality control for complex IT service delivery contracts.
* Experience coordinating with higher‑tier organizations such as RCC‑SWA, CENTCOM, and NETCOM for escalated support, enterprise integration, and change management.
* Strong understanding of configuration control, ITIL‑based service management, and enterprise patching and compliance processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordination with Government leadership, mission partners, and contractor personnel.
* Master’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Project Management Professional (PMP), ITIL v4 Managing Professional, CISSP, or CASP\+ certifications.
* Fifteen or more years of progressive leadership experience supporting Department of War (DoW) or U.S. Government IT operations in deployed or international environments.
* Demonstrated success managing multi‑discipline IT service delivery teams and coordinating with higher‑tier organizations such as RCC‑SWA, CENTCOM, and NETCOM.
* Experience developing and implementing Continuity of Operations (COOP) plans, risk mitigation strategies, and performance metrics aligned to Acceptable Quality Levels (AQLs).
* Proven ability to lead transition‑in and transition‑out activities, including staff mobilization, asset transfer, and knowledge handover.
* Background in cybersecurity policy implementation, configuration control, and change management within classified network environments.
* Strong interpersonal and cross‑cultural communication skills for collaboration with U.S. personnel and host‑nation counterparts.
* Requires a Secret Security Clearance.

* Cost and Commercial Management

**Job Title** 
 : Program Manager (PMO)
   

  

**Employment type** 
 : Contract (On\-site)
   

  

**Contract length** 
 : 6 \- 12 months
   

  

**Location** 
 : Riyadh, KSA
   

  

**PURPOSE OF THE PROJECT**
 We are seeking a highly organized and strategic Program Manager to lead the Debit Diversification Program in Saudi Arabia. This role will sit within our Consulting \& Analytics function and is designed to enhance credit and prepaid card penetration among existing Debit Cardholders by managing a wide range of activities including telesales hiring and supervision, sales training, and performance tracking.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**
* Oversee the entire Debit Diversification Program, ensuring timely and successful delivery of all components.
* Recruit, train, and manage a team of 4\-6 telesales agents per bank across seven participating banks to drive incremental outbound sales.
* Implement robust tracking systems to measure the effectiveness of sales activities and overall program impact.
* Develop detailed reports and templates for program updates and stakeholder communication.
* Engage with key stakeholders from leading banks in KSA to facilitate seamless program execution.
* Coordinate with Consulting \& Analytics to schedule and conduct in\-person sales training sessions, enhancing the sales skills of branch and direct sales staff.
* Organize sales competitions and incentive programs to motivate sales teams, ensuring alignment with program objectives.
* Oversee program budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and cost\-effectiveness.


**Knowledge and Experience:**
* 7\+ years of professional experience in program management, preferably within the financial services industry.
* Strong leadership skills with experience in team management and development.
* Excellent analytical skills and experience in data\-driven decision\-making.
* Proficiency in reporting tools and project management software.
* Fluency in Arabic and English.
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and engagement


**Mandatory Skills:**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's preferred).
* Previous experience within Banking, Digital Payment \& Card solutions, or the FinTech industry.
* Regional experience, including working in a faced\-paced matrix organisation.
* Excellent communication skills in English \& Arabic (written, verbal, and presentation).


**Preferred Skills:**
* The ability to analyse data, troubleshoot payment issues, optimize processes, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Good understanding of payment systems, digital platforms, system workflows, security basics, and industry technologies.
* An understanding of regional regulations across financial services or payment networks.

data.jd_text:
**About us** 




 EPAM Systems is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and software development services. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Newtown, Pennsylvania, EPAM has been helping clients navigate digital transformation for over 30 years, delivering innovative solutions to stay competitive in constantly evolving markets.
 



 As consultants, designers, architects, engineers and trainers, at EPAM, we specialize in building long\-term partnerships, enabling businesses to reimagine themselves through a digital lens. In Saudi Arabia, EPAM operates in Riyadh and Al Khobar, offering cutting\-edge engineering, strategy, design, consulting, and innovation services across industries.
 



  
 



  
 



 We're looking for a
 **Director, Technology Consulting – Telecom SME** 
 to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in a hybrid working mode with onsite client presence in KSA and UAE.
 



 In this senior advisory role, you will act as a trusted partner to telecom clients, helping shape strategies and deliver innovative solutions that enable business transformation and sustainable growth. You will influence high\-impact digital initiatives, manage executive relationships and contribute to building value\-driven propositions that set our clients apart in a competitive market.
 



**The deadline for submission is 15/07/2026\.** 




  
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Act as the primary telecom subject matter expert for key clients, ensuring successful delivery and client satisfaction
* Co\-develop account plans and growth strategies in partnership with Account Managers
* Lead business transformation initiatives, product strategy and roadmap development
* Shape and scope complex solutions while defining engagement strategies and delivery governance
* Support contract negotiations and maintain accurate pipeline forecasting for predictable outcomes
* Develop telecom\-focused value propositions, pilot with regional clients and scale globally
* Drive revenue growth across assigned accounts and promote end\-to\-end capabilities of EPAM
* Establish and strengthen senior client relationships to identify additional opportunities
* Deliver against revenue and profitability targets aligned with business objectives
* Stay current with emerging telecom technologies, trends and regulatory dynamics impacting the sector







**Requirements** 



* 10\+ years of experience in technology consulting or advisory roles within the telecom domain
* Comprehensive knowledge of B2C, B2B and wholesale models as well as full\-stack implementations (channels/BSS/OSS)
* Proven ability to manage complex enterprise engagements in consulting or IT delivery environments
* Strategic mindset combined with the ability to execute and deliver measurable value
* Deep understanding of platforms, business models and innovations in the telecom sector
* Demonstrated success managing performance metrics across multiple accounts
* Expertise in consulting, strategic planning and solution delivery within large\-scale programs
* Strong network across the Middle East telecom ecosystem, including clients, analysts and partners
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills in Arabic and English
* Familiarity with GenAI technologies and ability to evaluate AI\-driven product opportunities
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; MBA or equivalent is an advantage







**Nice to have** 



* Experience in global consulting environments with cross\-functional leadership exposure
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements in the Middle East



  
 



**We offer** 



* General Organization for Social Insurance (GOSI)
* Private healthcare and life insurance
* End of service gratuity
* Annual air travel allowance for expatriates
* Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards
* Learning and development opportunities including in\-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses



  
 



**Nature of Work and Working Hours** 




 The usual working hours for full\-time roles at EPAM in Saudi Arabia are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including a one\-hour unpaid lunch break. Working hours may vary based on client requirements and flexibility is accommodated whenever possible.
 



**Our Locations in Saudi Arabia** 




**Riyadh** 
 \- Moon Tower, Mezzanine Floor, King Fahed Branch Road, AR Rahmaniyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
 



**Al Khobar** 
 \- 21st Floor, Khobar Gate Tower, Al Bandariyah District, King Fahd Road, Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia
 



**How to Apply, Recruitment Process and Deadline** 




 If you meet the requirements and are eager to join EPAM, simply submit your application online by clicking on "apply” and providing your up to date CV and/or LinkedIn profile and other optional materials live cover letters and portfolios.
 



 Once applied, you will have a conversation with our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a technical interview and an interview with the hiring manager; a client interview may also be included in some cases. If successful, you'll receive an offer and, upon acceptance, officially become part of our team. We look forward to welcoming you aboard!
 



 Join EPAM today and contribute to shaping the future of technology while growing your career in a supportive, global work environment.

data.jd_text:
Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you the strategic mastermind who can turn complex aviation regulations into a symphony of safety and performance?
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with teams across Flight Operations, Ground Operations, Engineering, and Maintenance to embed quality, compliance, and accountability into every aspect of the operation, ensuring the highest standards of safety and performance.
   

  

 Take the lead in establishing, implementing, and continuously enhancing quality management systems and compliance monitoring frameworks that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry best practices.
   

  

 Drive operational excellence by overseeing audits, compliance assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective risk management, audit readiness, and the successful closure of findings across all operational areas.
   

  

 Ensure quality and compliance risks are proactively identified, assessed, and mitigated through robust monitoring, transparent reporting, and corrective action plans that safeguard operational integrity and regulatory adherence.
   

  

 Hold authority to interface with regulatory bodies on compliance\-related matters, including securing approvals, responding to regulatory inquiries, managing certifications such as Third Country Operator (TCO) authorization, and representing the organization during audits and inspections.
   

  

 Lead and develop high\-performing quality and compliance teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and operational accountability while ensuring sustainable compliance leadership and decision\-making continuity.
   

  

 Drive a culture of ownership, governance, and regulatory discipline by holding self and others accountable for delivering commitments, maintaining compliance standards, and achieving operational objectives.
   

  

 Promote transparency through performance monitoring, timely escalation of risks and findings, and the effective execution of corrective actions to ensure sustainable compliance and operational excellence.
   

  

 Join us to shape world\-class quality assurance and compliance programs, strengthen regulatory excellence, and drive safe, efficient, and industry\-leading operations across the organization.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, y ou will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years in airline quality assurance and compliance.
   

  

 You are expected to demonstrate an in\-depth knowledge of aviation regulations, safety standards, and industry best practices.
   

  

 We'd love to hear from you even more if you are able to lead a team, and are familiar with GACA (General Authority of Civil Aviation) regulations.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

data.jd_text:
**Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on\-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia** 
 by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF).
   

  

  

  

 Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun.
 **Here, teamwork rules, and work feels as exciting as the events we create.** 
 Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non\-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large\-scale events scene.
   

  

  

  

 Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of
 **record\-breaking events** 
 : LEAP and Cityscape \- the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA \- a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East \- the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 As a Senior Project Manager working with Portfolio 2 delivery teams, you will be responsible for developing detailed project plans and timelines.
   

  





 You will be involved in breaking down the event into key phases (e.g., pre\-event, event execution, and post\-event), identifying major deliverables, and creating a project schedule. You will coordinate with all stakeholders, define the scope, set expectations, and establish deadlines for each milestone.
   

  





  

  





**What You Will Do**




 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Act as the primary liaison between internal and external stakeholders, including event sponsors, exhibitors, clients, vendors, and internal teams (marketing, operations, technical teams, etc.).
* Ensure all stakeholders understand their roles, requirements, and timelines, fostering clear communication and alignment.
* Manage expectations and address concerns to maintain strong relationships and ensure smooth collaboration.



 Feature Management
   

  




* Oversee the planning and execution of event features such as workshops, deals hubs, competitions, activations, and closed\-door roundtable conferences.
* Manage these features from concept to delivery, ensuring they align with the event’s goals and enhance the attendee experience.
* Collaborate with operations and suppliers to bring innovative ideas to elevate the look, feel, and flow of the event.



 Risk Management
   

  




* Identify potential risks (e.g., venue issues, technical failures, supplier delays) and develop contingency plans to mitigate them.
* Maintain risk logs, assess impact, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure smooth event delivery.
* Continuously monitor risks throughout the project lifecycle and adapt plans as needed.



 Coordination of Multi\-Functional Teams
   

  




* Act as the central hub for coordinating efforts across various functional teams (marketing, logistics, technical, legal, etc.).
* Align tasks and timelines to avoid bottlenecks and ensure all teams are working toward the same goals.
* Maintain a broader view of the event flow to ensure seamless execution and integration of all components.



 Venue and Vendor Management
   

  




* Secure and manage venues, suppliers, and vendors, including negotiating contracts and ensuring timely delivery of goods and services.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with third\-party providers such as audio\-visual companies, caterers, and transportation services.
* Ensure all deliverables meet quality standards and align with the event’s vision.



 Communication and Reporting
   

  




* Establish regular meetings, status reports, and communication plans to keep all parties informed about progress, risks, and changes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for resolving issues during the project lifecycle.
* Provide clear and concise updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability.



 Post\-Event Evaluation and Reporting
   

  




* Conduct post\-event reviews to assess success metrics and gather feedback from stakeholders.
* Prepare a final report summarizing achievements, lessons learned, and recommendations for future events.
* Track post\-event milestones and support the rollout of new event launches.


**Qualifications**

**You will have:**



* Experience or exposure in managing mid – large scale trade exhibitions, conferences, sports events or FMCG launches and events
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deliverables at different stages of the project life cycle
* Exposure to evaluating and managing Inter\-departmental processes and milestones
* Stakeholder interaction and management, both internal teams and external partners across all levels
* Risk management and mitigation planning
* Exposure to MS Office/Office 365 suite of software, Smart Sheets and Airtable



**Demonstrated skills:**



* Ability to perform critical work involving judgement, accuracy and speed with minimal supervision
* Computer literate and proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel, Airtable and Smart Sheets.
* Able to prioritise work tasks, and deadlines, proficient in using scheduling tools
* Proactive and self\-motivated
* Interpersonal and customer\-facing skills
* Cultural awareness and sensitivity


**Additional Information**

**Please note this is a Freelancer, fixed term role.**




 We don't just accept difference, we celebrate it. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and circumstances and base hiring decisions on relevant qualifications and merit. We are proud to provide a disability\-friendly environment. If you require any support or adjustments to participate in our interview or selection processes, please let us know.

data.jd_text:
**Senior Project Manager – QC Laboratory**
 GCM DP RoW Projects
   

  

 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
   

  

 Are you an experienced QC Laboratory specialist with a strong track record in technology transfer, analytical method transfers and project management? Do you like to work in a strategic localization program where you act as the technical and project interface towards a local manufacturing partner? Do you want your contribution to have direct impact on patient access and long\-term manufacturing capabilities? Then this position could be a great opportunity for you.
   

  

**The position**
 This is a senior position within Quality Control Laboratory, dedicated to the Novo Nordisk KSA localization program. As Senior Project Manager – QC Laboratory, you will act as Work Package Owner (WPO) for the QC Laboratory aseptic manufacturing scope, supporting our local partner SaudiBIO in technology transfer, laboratory readiness, analytical method transfer and ramp\-up of operations – ensuring full alignment with Novo Nordisk Quality standards and regulatory requirements. You will report to the Program Head and be part of the program localization management team.
   

  

**Your new role**
 Acting as Senior Project Manager and QC Laboratory Work Package Owner gives you the opportunity to work on a large and strategic localization program with high visibility. Novo Nordisk provides technical, quality and project leadership in support of SaudiBIO as the local partner, and your primary role will be to drive and coordinate Novo Nordisk's QC Laboratory support activities across the program.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Your Tasks Will Include**
* Acting as Work Package Owner for the QC Laboratory, representing Novo Nordisk towards SaudiBIO.
* Coordinating QC Laboratory technology transfer and analytical method transfer activities.
* Supporting QC Laboratory design, setup, qualification and validation readiness.
* Providing guidance, training and mentoring to the local partner in line with Novo Nordisk standards.
* Safeguarding compliance with EU GMP, Novo Nordisk Quality requirements and local regulatory expectations.
* Managing milestones, risks and interfaces with other work packages.
* Supporting the QC Laboratory ramp\-up until stable routine operation is achieved.


**Your new department**
 In Global Manufacturing \& Supply, we cover the full value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo Nordisk products. We are more than 30,000 colleagues across the globe with the shared responsibility of scaling molecules, processes, devices, and products, dedicated to supplying life\-saving medicines to the patients who need them most.
   

  

 You will join GCM DP RoW, part of Novo Nordisk's Global Manufacturing Services (GMS) organization, which supports the establishment of sustainable manufacturing capabilities in markets where a local presence is required. The KSA localization program is a multi\-phase initiative developing local pharmaceutical manufacturing capabilities in Saudi Arabia in close collaboration with SaudiBIO. Phases 1 and 2 focus on revamping and upgrading existing facilities to enable finished products and aseptic manufacturing, while Phase 3 encompasses an EPC greenfield expansion for further localization – all contributing to Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 through sustainable, high\-quality pharmaceutical production in the Kingdom.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Qualifications**
 We are looking for a Senior Project Manager who thrives in complex, cross\-cultural environments and brings both technical depth and strong leadership. You'll bring with you:
   

  

* An advanced degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering or a similar discipline.
* Strong experience within QC Laboratories, including analytical methods, validation and GMP compliance.
* Proven experience with technology transfer and QC Laboratory readiness.
* Solid project management experience in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build trust across functions and partners.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.


**Working at Novo Nordisk**
 Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long\-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.
   

  

**Deadline**
 7 July 2026\. (Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis).
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
   

  

 At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

**Location \-** 
 Al Khobar/Riyadh
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The KSA Buildings \& Infrastructure (B\&I) Director is responsible for leading, growing, and elevating Bureau Veritas’ B\&I portfolio across the region. This strategic leadership role oversees the full product line performance—shaping the long‑term vision, delivering the annual P\&L, and ensuring excellence across all operations.
   

  

 The Director drives topline and gross margin delivery in close partnership with regional leadership, steering commercial strategy, optimizing delivery models, and ensuring high‑quality, efficient, and client‑centric execution. The role leads multidisciplinary teams across
 **Asset Management, Infrastructure Technical Inspections, Project \& Program Management, Environmental Services, and Commissioning** 
 , ensuring cohesive, high‑value solutions for clients.
   

  

 The Director also strengthens BV’s market presence across major sectors including
 **Hospitality, Entertainment, Tourism, Mega Projects, Developers, Contractors, Government Authorities, Urban Development, Smart Cities, Transportation Infrastructure, and Aviation** 
 , building trusted relationships and expanding BV’s impact on safe, sustainable, and resilient built environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement the regional B\&I growth strategy aligned with regional and global Product Line priorities.
* Drive portfolio expansion, commercial performance, and market penetration across all B\&I service domains.
* Lead the annual budgeting cycle and manage end‑to‑end P\&L accountability for revenue, sales, and gross margin.
* Ensure delivery quality in line with BV’s Operational Excellence standards and performance KPIs.
* Oversee regional commercial activities and support major pursuits, tenders, and key account development.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key customers across priority sectors.
* Lead operational governance through structured meetings, reviews, and performance follow‑up.
* Coach and develop teams, drive a high‑performance culture, and lead recruitment and performance assessments.
* Collaborate with Product Line and Area leadership to build a strong B\&I talent pipeline.
* Uphold BV’s Core Values, Code of Ethics, and the 3 Absolutes.
* Ensure rigorous compliance with BV procedures for technical governance, risk, and quality.


**Core Competencies**
**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Strategic thinker with strong decision‑making, accountability, and change‑leadership capability.
* Effective people leader who empowers teams and navigates matrix environments with ease.


**Commercial \& Client Excellence**
* Strong commercial acumen and ability to drive growth across diverse B\&I markets, including Transportation Infrastructure and Aviation.
* Skilled at long‑term client relationship development and key account management.

 Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record\-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape \- the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA \- a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East \- the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.
   

  





 Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large\-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Role Overview**




 This role brings deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making into the Investor and Startup Programme infrastructure. The primary mandate is designing the investment programmes and deal\-making activations that make Gaming event the strongest investment event in the global gaming calendar. The role also flexes across the broader Investor and startup program portfolio, supporting investor programming at other events where sector knowledge and investor relationships add value. The event provides the structure; this person provides the sector depth, does the heavy lifting with the gaming and tech investment community, and raises the bar on investor experience across every event they touch.
   

  





**Gaming Investment Programme**



* Design investment programmes and deal\-making formats for gaming conference that attract international investors, publishers, and funds and set a global standard for capital\-meets\-talent events


* Build and own the gaming investor pipeline from scratch: identify gaming VCs, publisher venture arms, sovereign funds with gaming mandates, angel networks, and accelerator programmes, and conduct targeted outreach.


* Manage the investor application and vetting process verifying fund credentials, investment thesis alignment, and genuine intent to engage with gaming studios and founders.


* Develop the content and format for all gaming investment activations: reverse pitches, hosted buyer programmes, closed\-door investor roundtables, and live deal\-making showcases.


* Work with the B2B Content Producer to ensure the investment content track is credible, current, and attracts the right calibre of participant.


* Design the investor experience end\-to\-end: investor lounge, curated sessions, concierge meetings, and investor\-only programming that delivers a premium environment.


* Own the investor\-side matchmaking process by working with internal teams to ensure match quality and deal relevance are high.


* Manage investor delegate communications, matchmaking logistics, and on\-site facilitation to ensure the programme delivers real outcomes, not just introductions.


* Track and report on investment programme outcomes: deals initiated, capital committed, follow\-up meetings generated.



**Cross\-Portfolio Investor Support**



* Support the investor programme across other Investor \& Startup program portfolio events contributing investor relationships, outreach, and programming input where sector knowledge adds value.


* Contribute to investor outreach campaigns across portfolio events with the marketing and cross\-functional teams.


* Provide investor program cover for senior team members during high\-volume pre\-event and on\-ground periods.


* Curate a balanced, high\-quality investor room for each assigned event, reflecting that event’s sector focus and strategic objectives.


* Programme investor\-focused roundtables, LP introductions, and deal\-flow sessions in collaboration with the special value programmes team.


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date investor records in internal management tools covering fund details, investment thesis, meeting history, and post\-event feedback.


* Track investor programme KPIs across assigned events: investor count, AUM represented, meetings held, investment signals generated, and investor NPS.


* Conduct post\-event investor debriefs, gather feedback, and share improvement recommendations with the program lead.


* Maintain and nurture investor relationships year\-round, ensuring warm relationships carry forward into future editions.


* Develop new ideas for value\-driven investor programme features and lead on concept note development for future editions.


**Qualifications**

  

  




* 4–5 years of experience in investor relations, investor programme management, or VC/LP engagement ideally within an event, ecosystem, or gaming industry context.
* Demonstrated expertise in the gaming investment landscape: VCs, publisher venture arms, sovereign funds with gaming mandates, angel networks. This is the core credential.
* Demonstrable experience curating and managing high\-touch investor experiences, not just registration and logistics, but genuine investor engagement design.
* Strong existing network within the gaming and tech investment community, particularly in MENA, APAC, or Europe.
* Understanding of how the gaming investment chain works from pre\-seed accelerators through to sovereign capital deployment.
* Sector knowledge in cybersecurity, fintech, or other technology verticals is an advantage for cross\-portfolio event support.
* Excellent relationship management skills, able to manage senior investor relationships with professionalism and discretion.
* Comfortable working across multiple simultaneous events with different investors, geographies, and sector focuses.
* Experience with investor management platforms, CRM tools, and event management systems.
* Strong written English is mandatory; Arabic is a meaningful advantage.
* **What You will bring**




 Deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making is the non\-negotiable. Must understand how funding rounds, publishing deals, and M\&A transactions work in gaming and know the regional investors, funds, and studios that matter, particularly across Saudi Arabia and MENA. Comfortable in investor conversations and able to hold their own in a room with fund managers, portfolio directors, and publishing executives. Able to design investor programmes from the ground up that bring international capital to an event and raise the bar on what a gaming investment activation can be. Equally capable of plugging into broader Investor and startup programs across events and adding immediate value through relationships and sector credibility.


**Additional Information**

**Please note this is a 6 month contract role. It can be performed remotely. We are not able to provide relocation or sponsorship support with the position.**




 We don't just accept difference, we celebrate it. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and circumstances and base hiring decisions on relevant qualifications and merit. We are proud to provide a disability\-friendly environment. If you require any support or adjustments to participate in our interview or selection processes, please let us know.

 The Senior Project Manager will own the project lifecycle from planning and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover. You will work cross\-functionally with academic leaders, operations, design teams, external consultants and contractors, and will be responsible for driving schedules, cost control, risk management and quality assurance in often complex, fast\-moving settings. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to present to senior leadership and external authorities.
* Demonstrable experience of site\-based project management, health \& safety compliance and quality assurance processes.

data.jd_text:
**Description:** 
 The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13\-213,
 *Airfield Driving* 
 . The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13\-204 and DAFI 13\-213\. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Must have a \*7\-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
* Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
* Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
* Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
* Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
* Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
* Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
* Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
* Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
* Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13\-213 and local directives.
* Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
* Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
* Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
* Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.

data.raw_snippet: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how mi
data.jd_text:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Anduril's Middle East team delivers cutting\-edge platforms, software\-first systems, and integrated effects from across Anduril's portfolio to regional customers, with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) serving as our primary growth anchor. The team adapts and applies Anduril's core hardware and software products to serve the unique national security and defense requirements of Saudi Arabia and the broader GCC. As this team rapidly expands its footprint in Riyadh, this role requires an applicant willing to take on diverse responsibilities. The Business Development (BD) team is responsible for identifying, shaping, capturing, and growing new opportunities and capabilities for the company. BD team members serve as the bridge between Saudi defense stakeholders and the broader Anduril team; they convey local operational requirements to our global enterprise while serving as the Anduril brand ambassador in\-Kingdom. They partner extensively with engineering and program management to ensure Anduril products exceed regional mission demands and align with KSA’s defense modernization goals.
   

  

**About The Job**
 We are looking for an Associate Director, Business Development (BD) based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to identify, shape, and capture opportunities to grow revenue within the Kingdom and the wider region. You will serve as the critical link between Saudi defense prospects/clients and our global product teams, translating local operational needs into the Product and Engineering pipelines to ensure Anduril’s suite of autonomous systems meets the Kingdom’s security demands. This role requires a high degree of initiative, localized cultural fluency, and a deep understanding of Saudi procurement. You will have direct ownership of shaping, capturing, and executing business development opportunities in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030 defense localization objectives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Find, pursue and close business within Saudi Arabia. This will involve extensive travel within the Kingdom, high\-level engagement at regional defense exhibitions (such as the World Defense Show), and deep responsibility for navigating KSA budget cycles and ministerial approval processes. Success will be achieved by developing deep relationships within the Ministry of Defense (MoD), Ministry of National Guard (MNG), Ministry of Interior (MoI), and presidency forces. You will monitor local buying cycles, lead specific proposal and capture efforts, and generate highly targeted growth strategies based on KSA’s threat landscape and strategic priorities.
* Develop capture strategies. Provide cohesive business plans and execution models that outline acquisition paths, create clear alignment to Saudi investment strategies, and drive towards programs of record. Success will be achieved by engaging key stakeholders—including the General Authority for Military Industries (GAMI) and Saudi Arabian Military Industries (SAMI)—to shape requirements, secure relevant funding, and develop localized industrialization and supplier strategies for competitive captures.
* Drive product adoption and program transition. Anduril thrives by developing new technologies for our clients' most pressing operational challenges, particularly in UAS, Counter\-UAS, and border security. You will drive the transition of nascent concepts into KSA operations through early\-stage pilot programs, field trials, and collaborative R\&D. Internally, you are charged with translating Saudi defense challenges back into our engineering organization, ensuring our product suite remains best\-in\-class for the region’s unique desert and maritime operating environments.
* Grow existing business. While the primary role is capturing new business, you will represent all Business Lines across Anduril's portfolio. You will partner with local execution teams, joint venture partners, and product engineers to scale our footprint with existing Saudi clients. This involves not only expanding current contracts but leveraging established relationships to explore new capabilities, sensor integrations, and localized software\-defined command and control (C2\) solutions.
* Communicate our value to clients. BD team members are brand ambassadors who represent Anduril to Saudi decision\-makers, local industrial partners, and the regional public. You must project the company's ethos, clearly communicating our software\-first approach, speed of innovation, and competitive edge in localized co\-production and technology transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of business development, military operational, or strategic sales experience interfacing directly with Saudi government decision\-makers (i.e. MoD, MNG, MoI, security forces), with deep expertise in GAMI regulations, localization mandates, and Saudi procurement processes.
* The ideal candidate will be a proven growth leader with prior experience in commercial or defense capture and sales within the Kingdom, demonstrating a track record of building, executing, and winning defense contracts under Saudi Vision 2030 guidelines.Prior acquisition or operational experience in\-Kingdom, with a strong understanding of Saudi Arabia’s strategic security priorities and threat environment.
* An aptitude and appetite to thrive within organizations with nascent structure, high\-ownership culture, and a "whatever it takes" environment.
* A knack for knocking out deliverables in an ambiguous environment, while maintaining a level\-head, strong interpersonal skills, and the cultural gravitas required to navigate senior\-level Saudi defense environments.
* Excellent writing and communication skills with experience briefing senior military commanders and executive leadership.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.
* Ability to travel 50%\-75% (predominantly within KSA and the Middle East, with occasional travel to US HQs).
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S., Canada, U.K., Australia, or New Zealand security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience shaping and leading capture efforts directly involving SAMI (Saudi Arabian Military Industries) or local Saudi defense\-industrial partners.
* Prior experience working with Foreign Military Sales (FMS), Direct Commercial Sales (DCS), and Saudi direct commercial procurement, including navigating ITAR, licensing, and technology releasability.
* Demonstrated knowledge of KSA defense modernization programs, with a history of zero\-to\-one program growth in the Middle East.
* Demonstrated high\-energy, high\-ownership individual who will drive performance and exhibit strong management skills with a high level of emotional intelligence and cultural awareness. Must be able to work in a fast\-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment, and adapt global technologies to the local market.
* Riyadh\-based or willing to permanently relocate to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
* Currently has and is able to maintain an active U.S., Canada, U.K., Australia, or New Zealand security clearance.
* Strong bilingual communication skills; fluency in both written and spoken Arabic and English.


**Benefits**
 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:
   

  

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.
 *For more information, Explore Our Benefits.*
**Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**
 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
   

  

 To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind
   

  

* No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* Please always verify communications:
+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

* Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.


**Data Privacy**
 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/.
   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
