Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know\-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands\-on support to help it scale.
   

  

 Miza is one of those ventures building a digital wealth management platform on a mission to democratize access to exclusive global investment opportunities. We provide high\-net\-worth individuals with access to top\-tier private funds, pre\-IPO deals, and alternative investments opportunities traditionally gated by high minimums and opaque networks. We are reimagining the private wealth experience through a hybrid of cutting\-edge technology and curated investment access. This is not a traditional brokerage this is a platform where HNWIs can effortlessly participate in some of the world's most compelling private funds across multiple asset classes.
   

  

 We are looking for a Managing Investments Associate (CME1 and CME4 required) to take real ownership across portfolio construction, fund operations, and counterparty management from day one reporting directly to the CEO.
   

  

**THE ROLE What You'll Own Here.**
 Counterparty Management
   

  

* Day\-to\-day handling of relationships with external partners fund houses, custodians, distribution platforms, and global asset managers
* Coordinate execution and operational flows across counterparties; ensure subscriptions, redemptions, and capital calls are handled cleanly and on time
* Serve as Miza's point of contact for routine operational and investment queries from these partners Portfolio Construction \& Screening
* Support the investment team in screening funds, managers, and strategies for inclusion in client portfolios
* Build and maintain the investment universe, due diligence packs, comparative analyses, and fee benchmarking
* Run periodic portfolio reviews and rebalancing analyses Investment Writing
* Produce investment memos, fund summaries, market commentaries, and client\-facing investment notes
* Translate technical investment content between English and Arabic for client communications
* Maintain quality and consistency across all investment documentation Fund Operations \& Dealing
* Support trade execution across asset classes funds, equities, and fixed income
* Reconcile positions, confirmations, and settlements with the operations team
* Help maintain and improve internal investment processes as Miza scales


 How Success Will Be Measured Accuracy and timeliness of counterparty operations, quality and consistency of investment documentation, contribution to portfolio construction and screening, and reliability across fund operations as Miza scales.
   

  

 Where This Role Can Go Managing Investments Associate → Senior Investments seat as Miza scales its platform and client base across the region.
   

  

**THE PROFILE You're probably a fit if…**
 You have 2–3 years of relevant experience in asset management, wealth management, private banking, or investment operations
   

  

 You hold CME1 and CME4 certifications (mandatory)
   

  

 You're fluent in Arabic and English written and spoken
   

  

 You have strong attention to detail and are comfortable working with numbers, fund documentation, and reconciliations
   

  

 You've demonstrated the ability to use AI tools to improve real workflows, not just for drafting
   

  

 Bonus: experience in private markets, alternative investments, or global funds; background in a CMA\-regulated environment
   

  

**THE ENVIRONMENT What Working Here Actually Looks Like.**
 1\- IC\-First Ownership You execute without a layer of management around you. This is a role for someone who takes initiative and follows through without needing to be managed.
   

  

 2\- Direct Impact on the Business Small mistakes here compound, so reliability is non\-negotiable. What you do or don't do moves the business directly.
   

  

 3\- A Role That Grows With You This position has a clear path into a senior investments seat as Miza scales its platform and expands its client base across the region.
   

  

 What You Get From Us
   

  

 Meaningful work from day one: You won't be a cog
   

  

 you will shape how this business runs. Real autonomy: Freedom from bureaucracy and the trust to own your function. Exposure to global private markets: Access to top\-tier private funds, pre\-IPO deals, and alternative investments at the frontier of wealth management in Saudi Arabia. Mentorship that matters: Direct collaboration with the CEO and founding team. An accelerated curve: You'll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.
   

  

 Hiring Process Introductory recruiter conversation → CEO interview → Technical investment exercise → Reference checks → Offer

 Raytheon’s National Advanced Surface\-to\-Air Missile System (NASAMS) Program Team is seeking an

 This accompanied role will be in Doha, Qatar for a 2\-year international assignment on a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with potential extension.
   

  

 Ability to travel internationally (up to 25%) as needed.
   

  

 Employment is contingent upon meeting all medical requirements for overseas assignments including comprehensive post\-offer medical examination.
   

  

**What You Will Do**

* Ensure subcontractor commitments meet financial, technical, and schedule requirements, escalating issues to the CONUS Program Manager as needed.
* Collaborate with internal functions, such as MRAD, Engineering, Contracts, Finance, Supply Chain, and Quality, to enhance program success.
* Manage subcontractor lifecycle deliverables and support customer program reviews and visits.
* Lead, mentor, and motivate the in\-country team to achieve program objectives while fostering a culture aligned with corporate vision and values.


**Qualifications You Must Have**
* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and 12\+ years of relevant experience or an Advanced degree and minimum 10\+ years of experience.
* PMX Certification Level 4, or ability to obtain within 12 months.
* CORE certification or process improvement equivalent.
* 7\+ years of experience in Program Management and Risk \& Opportunity Measures.
* Experience with large Air Defense weapon systems and prior military.
* Experience in program execution across System Integration, Fielding, Training, Operations, and Sustainment.
* Experience with financial analysis tools and project management tools and/or systems.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proven ability to effectively lead a cross\-functional team in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively work with international customers.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued Secret security clearance is required.
* U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


**Qualifications We Prefer**
* MBA or a graduate degree in engineering.
* Experience working in MENA region.
* Experience as a Senior Non\-commissioned Officer.
* Experience in international program execution, including collaboration with large international subcontractors and US Government programs.
* Strong working knowledge of EX/IM regulations, security requirements, and subcontract formation, execution, and management.
* Skilled in developing and reviewing cost proposals, as well as preparing Proposal Review and Contract Start\-up packages for management approval.
* Expertise in supporting development, production, sustainment, and execution of complex weapon systems, preferably within the aerospace and defense industry.
* Proficient in using Program Management tools or equivalent systems.
* NASAMS program experience in execution or capture phases.


**What We Offer**
 Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
   

  

**Clearance Information:** 
 This position requires security clearance. The Defense Industrial Security Clearance Office (DISCO), an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978\.htm

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
* Responsible for implementation of Target Operating Model (TOM) across the International Branches and Subsidiaries
* Conduct Domain Assessment, Evaluation and Gap Analysis, Regulatory requirements, and report periodically
* Support EVP / direct manager in governance implementation and day\-to\-day governance responsibilities over branches and subsidiaries.
* Assist in reviewing and implementing Policies \& Procedures re\-engineering,
* Coordinate various projects to grow the usage of the Group’s International banking branches / products in line with corporate initiatives.
* Assist in implementing Quality assurance framework in all designated countries.
* Support Domain Owner to Control and Monitor all ongoing implementation of new products, systems and processes in designated countries.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Provide required information to Domain Owner to Create Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes pertaining to the services / activities performed by the branches and subsidiaries.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President Central Operations Relationship Management
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Instruct and co\-ordinate with the related user departments and International Branches to secure the requirements and schedule for the respective projects/facilities maintenance works execution.
* Co\-ordinate with the Domain Owner plan Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Provide required support to international branches/subsidiaries in TOM implementation roll\-out plan in respect to products implementation, operational training and guidance,
* Gather Country specific requirements from international branches/subsidiaries in initiation of new business opening.
* Review Business Requirements draft \& branch procedures received from related parties and provide review input and obtain approvals from stakeholders when required.
* Ensure International branches/subsidiaries are reporting Daily, Weekly and Monthly operational activities, monitor the reports, and take necessary action if required.
* Monitor and escalate compliance related issues to Group Compliance and communicate Business decision to relevant international unit.
* Coordinate in all banking projects for various corporate initiatives including acquisition conversions, systems changes, new products, services, and product enhancements.
* Ensure direct oversight of high\-volume activity, consistently complex issues and/ or high\-level risk and exposure items that have a significant impact on the achievement of the objectives of the department and potentially the International Operations Department.
* Support in efficiency management, quality improvement, and system optimization projects.
* Effectively interact with other operating units, managers and stakeholders.
* Coordinate and guide International Branches and Subsidiaries to take necessary action on Internal/External audit observation, recommendation within target date until closure.
* Periodic visit to international branches and assess respective domains are in line. Continuous improvement
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Provide direct support and guidance to project managers, supervisors, and analysts to international branch users.
* Maintain a high level of knowledge about electronic banking, Core Banking and its processes, international regulations, and generally accepted operating practices. Research industry topics and react by recommending changes to products, services, and systems
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and your team's overall performance on a regular basis.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defense principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need\-to\-know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelors University graduate preferably with a Major in Marketing, Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or Information Technology (related field of study), Masters preferred
* 10 years of experience of Electronic Banking \& Operations experience of which at least 5 years in managing International Operations.
* Full Banking Operational knowledge and experiences to guide all International Branches from opening to going live and continuous support.
* Full Compliance expertise to meet Regulatory requirements in International Branches
* High\-level document writing capability such as, Business requirements, Procedure and guidance document for all products and Branches position levels.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport
* Educational Certificates

data.jd_text:
**Mandatory Requirement: This role is strictly limited to candidates from EdTech backgrounds with proven AI application experience in learning or education platforms** 




  





 Antal is partnering with a multinational conglomerate operating across Central America and other regions to establish a
 **national EdTech transformation division in Qatar** 
 .
 



  





 This initiative is a
 **large\-scale, AI\-enabled education modernization program** 
 designed to support the evolution of Qatar’s education ecosystem through integrated curriculum transformation, certification alignment, teacher enablement, and a unified AI\-powered learning platform.
 



  





 The program is being developed in close collaboration with:
 


* Ministry\-level stakeholders
* Global curriculum and certification partners
* A founding advisory group of education and technology experts



  





**Job Title \- Founding Managing Director / Program COO** 




**Compensation \- $12,000 to $15,000 \+ Benefits \+ Bonus** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a
 **Founding Managing Director / Program COO** 
 to lead the transformation of a national AI\-enabled education initiative from concept to pilot and ultimately to large\-scale deployment.
 



 This role is responsible for converting a strategic vision into a
 **structured, executable, and scalable operating system** 
 spanning curriculum integration, teacher enablement, certification alignment, and AI\-enabled learning infrastructure.
 



 This is a
 **true builder\-operator role** 
 , not a traditional program management position. The individual will act as the central execution leader across technology, curriculum, partners, governance, and institutional stakeholders.
 



  





**Mandate** 




 The Program COO will serve as the
 **operational backbone of the initiative** 
 , responsible for building and running the entire execution ecosystem, including partners, pilots, delivery systems, and governance structures.
 



 They will coordinate across:
 


* Chief AI / Systems Architect
* Curriculum and certification partners
* Technology and platform vendors
* Teacher enablement teams
* Government / Ministry and institutional stakeholders
* Pilot schools and deployment teams



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**1\. End\-to\-End Implementation Architecture** 




**2\. Partner \& Ecosystem Orchestration** 




**3\. Teacher Intelligence Lab Buildout** 




**4\. Pilot Deployment Execution** 




**5\. Platform \& Technology Coordination** 




**6\. Government \& Institutional Readiness** 




**7\. Operating Model \& Team Buildout** 




**8\. Governance \& Execution Discipline** 




  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate is a
 **technology\-driven education transformation leader** 
 with strong execution depth.
 



  





**Must\-have experience:** 



* Top\-tier academic background (IIT / IIM / IISc / NIT or equivalent) preferred
* 12–20\+ years in:
* EdTech / digital learning platforms
* AI\-enabled education systems
* Enterprise learning / corporate academies
* Large\-scale digital transformation programs
* Experience working with major global technology or consulting ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft, Google, IBM, Accenture, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Samsung or similar)
* Proven ability to lead multi\-stream, multi\-stakeholder programs at scale
* Strong exposure to K–12 education systems or teacher enablement platforms



  





**Core capabilities:** 



* Strong understanding of AI applications in learning ecosystems
* Ability to translate strategy into execution systems
* Experience building operating models from scratch
* Strong stakeholder management (government, enterprise, institutional)
* High execution discipline (PMP / SAFe or equivalent exposure preferred)
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and early\-stage environments
* AI\-fluent in day\-to\-day workflows



  





**Leadership Traits** 



* Highly structured and execution\-oriented
* Strong systems thinker
* Calm under pressure
* Strong communicator across technical and non\-technical audiences
* Entrepreneurial mindset
* Comfortable building while operating
* Long\-term potential to evolve into Group COO



  





**Not a Fit If** 



* Pure academic with no delivery experience
* Theoretical AI researcher without implementation exposure
* Traditional school administrator without tech depth
* Junior program/project manager
* Consultant focused on documentation over execution
* Operator of existing systems without prior zero\-to\-one builds



  





**First 90\-Day Outcomes** 




 The candidate should be capable of delivering:
 


* End\-to\-end implementation roadmap
* Partner dependency and integration matrix
* Teacher Intelligence Lab operating model
* Pilot deployment blueprint
* Initial organization structure and hiring plan
* Technology and infrastructure coordination plan
* Ministry\-ready execution deck
* Budget and resource plan for pilot phase
* Governance and reporting framework
* Risk and mitigation register

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the divisional project portfolio through robust governance, data\-informed planning, and change enablement, working hand in hand with the Product Development \& Design (PDD) PMO team. You will ensure that all PDD initiatives are governed effectively, executed in accordance with best\-in\-class methodologies, and strategically synchronized with Qatar Airways governance forums such as the Group\-level Enterprise Program Management Office (EPMO). The role champions the PDD agenda in line with the GCEO vision and the direction set by the SVP Product Development \& Design, while fostering innovation and continuous improvement in how projects are planned, governed, and delivered.
   

  

 As part of your role, your responsibilities will be inclusive of, but not limited to the following:
   

  

**Strategic Governance \& Synchronization**
* Establish and maintain a divisional project governance framework that ensures consistency, transparency, and adherence to the QR 2\.0 vision and the QR Group strategic priorities.
* Ensure synchronization of PDD project efforts with enterprise\-wide programs, including EPMO\-led initiatives, while maintaining focus on divisional priorities and outcomes.
* Translate the SVP PDD’s strategic direction into actionable governance practices that prioritize innovation, customer\-centricity, and design excellence.
* Promote the adoption of modern project management methodologies (e.g. Process Excellence / Lean Six Sigma, Agile, PMBOK) to elevate execution discipline and delivery quality across the division.
* Act as the strategic interface between PDD and enterprise governance bodies, ensuring seamless integration of reporting, planning cycles, and performance tracking.


**Portfolio Oversight \& Performance Monitoring**
* Oversee the PDD project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are prioritized, sequenced, and resourced in line with strategic objectives and enterprise transformation goals.
* Define and track success metrics (KPIs and OKRs) to support business case approvals with the investment committees, measure project impact, alignment, and execution effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools to provide leadership with real\-time visibility into project health, risks, and strategic alignment.
* Conduct post\-project analysis to generate insights and feed improvements back into the strategy cycle.


**Data\-Driven Strategy \& Insight**
* Use data to guide project prioritization, feasibility assessments, and approach selection.
* Monitor performance through real\-time analytics on KPIs, milestones, budget variance, and risk indicators.
* Quantify project value using ROI, NPV, cost\-benefit analysis, CSAT and NPS to support strategic decision making.
* Apply forecasting and scenario planning to anticipate risks, resource constraints, and execution challenges.
* Leverage stakeholder feedback, benchmarking, and historical data to refine planning accuracy and communication strategies.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Leadership**
* Engage with senior stakeholders across PDD and the enterprise including Business Finance and Transformation to ensure shared ownership, alignment, and accountability for project outcomes.
* Apply structured change management methodologies to assess change impact, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure successful adoption of new processes and systems.
* Lead the development and implementation of change strategies that support smooth transitions and minimize disruption.
* Encourage innovative approaches to solving business challenges, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and agility.


**Risk Management \& Continuous Improvement**
* Anticipate risks that may impact project delivery, strategic synchronization, or stakeholder engagement, and develop proactive mitigation strategies.
* Conduct regular governance reviews and audits to ensure compliance with internal standards and regulatory requirements.
* Capture and share lessons learned to continuously refine planning and governance practices across the division.
* Champion a culture of accountability, transparency, and learning within the PDD project management community.

 Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future, and build the life you want while being part of an international community. Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with minimum 8 years of related experience.
* Understanding of design methodology and brand execution within the airline industry or similar.
* Previous experience in product development design phases including the ability to script product development phases will be an added advantage.
* Complete understanding of product design processes, technologies and design theory.
* Ability to multi\-task and adhere to deadlines.
* Excellent knowledge all industry standard design tools for 2D and 3D visualization.
* Experience applying theories related to colour, materials, layout, product engineering, graphics, textiles and various visual communication techniques.
* Love of experience design and a passion for learning.
* Managerial skills \- Ability to delegate work, set clear direction and manage workflow. Strong mentoring and coaching skills. Ability to train and develop subordinate's skills. Ability to foster teamwork among team members.


**About**
**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community
   

  

**How To Apply**

**Job Description**
**Construction Director – Infrastructure**
**Doha, Qatar**
 Parsons is seeking a highly experienced and accomplished
 **Construction Director (Infrastructure)** 
 to lead a portfolio of 17 major infrastructure projects in Qatar. The program includes roads, utilities, drainage systems, landscaping, and pump stations for a highly demanding client that requires exceptional delivery standards, responsiveness, and stakeholder management.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Plan, direct, and control all technical, commercial, financial, and administrative aspects across multiple concurrent infrastructure projects.
* Ensure all program requirements and deliverables meet the client stringent standards and expectations.
* Lead the preparation and implementation of key management plans, including Project Execution Plans, Health and Safety Plans, and QA/QC procedures.
* Assign responsibilities to senior team members in line with their expertise and project requirements, ensuring clear accountability.
* Manage scope variations and lead commercial and contractual negotiations with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Maintain strong client engagement, acting as the primary point of contact with the client and other key stakeholders.
* Operate effectively in a high\-demand environment, including extended working hours, as required by the client.
* Identify project and program risks, including delays and cost overruns, and implement proactive mitigation and recovery strategies.
* Oversee site operations, including labor coordination, procurement, logistics, and commercial controls.
* Ensure accurate and timely management of change orders, claims, and contractual documentation.
* Promote a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement across all projects under your leadership.
* Monitor progress against milestones and KPIs, and provide clear reporting on performance, risks, and corrective actions.
* Lead regular progress and coordination meetings with internal teams, clients, consultants, and subcontractors.
* Support business development initiatives, including client relationship management and contribution to securing additional work.
* Participate in staff evaluations, mentoring, and development planning to build and maintain a high\-performing team.


**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical or business discipline.
* 20 years of relevant experience, including strong project and construction management expertise on large\-scale infrastructure projects.
* Minimum of 3 years of work experience in Qatar (mandatory).
* Proven experience in senior leadership roles such as Construction Director, Principal Project Manager, or equivalent.
* Extensive background in operations management, including oversight of personnel, site operations, and facilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and teams in a fast\-paced, client\-driven environment.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with claims, variations, and contract administration.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven leadership, team\-building, and mentoring capabilities.


**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration (MBA).
* Professional certifications such as PMP or equivalent.
* Prior experience working with Ashghal (Public Works Authority, Qatar) is preferred.
* Experience delivering major infrastructure programs in the GCC region.
* Experience implementing program\-level performance management, digital project controls, and reporting systems.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The overall role for the position is to assist SVP/ VP to drive cultural change around Lean across QNB Group. The incumbent will be responsible for leading and managing the Group’s Lean and Six Sigma agenda under the Innovation department. Responsibility includes owning, leading and managing selected portfolio of Lean projects across QNB Group’s international network with minimal supervision.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial: \- Deliver and execute on the initiation, execution and implementation of operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives under his/ her scope and support divisions within QNB Group \- Assist the VP to develop and deploy Lean/ Six Sigma/ Change Management standards and the process improvement methodology within QNB Group \- Contribute to develop/ create the metrics/ key performance indicators (KPIs), for performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes related to dedicated operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives on a periodic basis \- Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President, Lean Transformation role. \- Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank. \- Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
* Customer (Internal \& External): \- Ensure relevant training and coaching on the methodology to designated multipliers within the organization \- Drive operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives under his/ her scope, with a focus on customer orientation, service and service quality \- Act as a partner to the concerned business and support divisions and lead process improvement projects together with representatives from one or more business and support divisions and \- Deliver training and coaching of others in applying Lean/ Six Sigma and process reengineering methodology \- Assist in creating awareness within QNB Group for client orientation, quality and efficiency \- Establish and maintain strong working relationships and support units within QNB Group with regards to operational excellence, reengineering and end\-to\-end process improvement initiatives as well as with regards to Lean/ Six Sigma tools \- Identify new solutions or processes into ongoing operations within QNB Group.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory): \- Interact with SVP/ VP Lean Transformation to obtain new process improvement mandates and participate in project idea generation, selection and scoping \- Support the business and support divisions in successfully managing and leading the implementation of strategic initiatives under his/ her scope \- Identify benefits, quantify targeted results, establish measurement criteria and assist in the prioritization of process improvement initiatives \- Manage or assist the VP to manage multiple projects and/ or assume the role of leading a larger projects under his/ her scope \- Direct and control all work performed within the project framework of the DMAIC phases \- Ensure projects under his/ her scope remain on time, on budget and deliver expected results \- Ensure industry best practices and standards within the execution of process improvement assignments \- Evaluate data and trends to identify improvement opportunities and associated issues and risks and perform statistical process analyses \- Provide advice, input and guidance to process improvement teams regarding change management, process redesign strategies, performance improvement toolsets (especially those of Six Sigma and Lean), and technical expertise, such as statistical process control and data analysis \- Coach internal process improvement teams to further refine and develop Lean/ Six Sigma tools within QNB Group to improve the quality and service \- Participate in the deployment of other performance improvement methodologies.
* Learning \& Knowledge: \- Identify related areas for professional self\-development. Ensure the provision of relevant guidance, direction and training to subordinates to develop and enhance their skills \- Defines further training needs required and is responsible for career development of his subordinates \- Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities. \- Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities: \- Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy). \- Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks. \- Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy. \- Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements. \- Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role. \- Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence. \- Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other: \- Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information. \- Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators. \- Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position. \- All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
 Bachelor Degree from leading academic institution with focus on business administration
   

  

* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in organization and process reengineering, business consulting and project management or equivalent business/ operations experience within the financial services arena (however: no specialization in one area but rather multiskilling and transversal across functions)
* Strong operational and project management experience \- Experience in directing and managing large projects as well as managing change
* Certified Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt with minimum of 5 years’ experience and technical mastery
* Demonstrated track record using Lean Six Sigma Methodology principles and practices
* Minimum of two years’ experience as lead instructor to train Black Belts and/ or Green Belts
* Experience in coaching a minimum of five Lean Six Sigma projects from initiation to closure
* Demonstrated career development, progress, and excellent team leadership skills and potential
* Strong knowledge of financial services from an operational and support perspective


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Highest Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 The Digital Office Manager holds a pivotal role in steering the organization's digital evolution. As the strategic leader overseeing digital initiatives, you will be at the forefront of innovation, responsible for driving the entire lifecycle of digital projects, from conception to realization.
   

  

 The Digital Office Manager reporting directly to the Chief Technical Officer (CTO) and collaborate closely with key stakeholders across the business to understand the intricacies of operational challenges. The primary focus will be on identifying emerging technologies and cutting\-edge processes and orchestrating their seamless integration into our business operations.
   

  

 Digital Office Manager will serve as the connection between conceptualizing transformative ideas and executing practical solutions. The mission is not only to keep a vigilant eye on the technological landscape but also to align these advancements with our organizational goals. By leveraging your expertise, the role holder will contribute to the development and implementation of innovative strategies that drive our digital transformation agenda forward.
   

  

 The role demands a visionary mindset and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. The Digital Office Manager will be instrumental in shaping and executing our digital strategy, ensuring that each digital engagement is finely tuned to meet our business objectives. The impact will extend beyond traditional boundaries by guiding the team in harnessing the power of digital technologies to address complex challenges and optimize operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* To ensure interpreting the digital strategy and to identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Drive QAFCO's digital vision and strategy definition, acting as the steward for the digital initiatives' roadmap across the organization.
* Identify and ideate digital business opportunities across the value chain, based on strategic and operational challenges or threats observed within the organization.
* Oversee the development of an integrated digital budget and spend plan across relevant QAFCO functions, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Identify synergies for developing and implementing digital solutions, collaborating with respective owners to ensure cohesive integration.
* Review digital value realization (i.e., ROI) across functions, ensuring that digital investments align with business objectives and deliver tangible outcomes.
* Develop relevant digital expertise through a Center of Excellence model, tailored to meet evolving business needs and technological advancements.
* Oversee the digital use case lifecycle delivery, from design and prototyping to full\-scale roll\-out, ensuring seamless execution and integration into existing processes.
* Lead and oversee the development of sustainable partnerships with local and global innovation ecosystems, fostering collaboration and driving digital innovation within QAFCO.
* Act as the single point of contact and key advisor to relevant QAFCO executives for digital topics and the future of the business, providing strategic guidance and insights.
* Act as the face of QAFCO in local and global digital and innovation events, seminars, and associations, representing the organization and fostering relationships with key stakeholders in the digital ecosystem.
* Interpret the digital strategy and identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Manage and evaluate the portfolio/pipeline of innovative ideas collected from across the company.
* Work closely with relevant business stakeholders to understand operational challenges or threats.
* Lead teams to build and implement digital products, tracking implementation progress and ensuring alignment with business and IT.
* Monitor the implementation of the digital strategy and roadmap, identifying risks, issues, and challenges, and seeking mitigation measures.
* Lead the ideation program to identify digital opportunities, ensuring compliance with relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management procedures and controls.


**Desired Candidate Profile**
* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field.
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in digital implementation, innovation, or a related field, with minimum 5 years in a managerial role, preferably within the Oil \& Gas or Petrochemical Industry.
* Certifications in project management, such as PMP (Project Management Professional) would be added as an advantage.

data.jd_text:
Lead the successful delivery of advanced venue technology solutions across stadiums, sports venues, and large\-scale international sporting events. **Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the overall delivery lifecycle of Venue Technology projects from concept initiation through planning, procurement, implementation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.
* Manage RFP preparation, tendering activities, vendor evaluations, contract coordination, and post\-award project execution activities.
* Develop and maintain project documentation, governance artefacts, technical specifications, implementation plans, and reporting frameworks for all Venue Technology initiatives.
* Oversee project execution in coordination with vendors, consultants, contractors, and internal project management teams.
* Develop integrated project plans aligned with operational, engineering, and event delivery requirements across stadiums, venues, clubs, and mega\-event environments.
* Define and document functional and technical requirements for venue technology systems and infrastructure.
* Support Venue Technology Operations teams and event organizers in defining project scope, operational expectations, and technical delivery requirements.
* Monitor project performance, risks, issues, timelines, budgets, and quality standards to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity standards, and venue operational guidelines.
* Lead contract performance management activities to ensure vendor compliance, service quality, and client satisfaction throughout project execution and delivery phases.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, integration validation, operational readiness, and transition\-to\-operations activities.



  





**Delivery Resource Planning \& Governance** 




  




* Manage and report on the progress of all Venue Technology projects and delivery programs.

* Lead service coordination meetings with vendors, consultants, operators, and external stakeholders.
* Manage the activities and performance of the Venue Technology Delivery team to ensure alignment with project objectives and operational requirements.
* Ensure all designs and implementations are compatible with venue operational standards, technology lifecycle requirements, scalability, and future expansion needs.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical direction to team members and project resources.
* Support strategic planning initiatives related to venue technology transformation and innovation.

**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**Required Skills \& Competencies** 




  




* Proven experience delivering large\-scale ICT, AV, and ELV projects within stadiums, arenas, smart venues, or mega\-event environments.

* Experience in designing, implementing, and managing venue\-based technology solutions for international sporting events.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, governance frameworks, and delivery best practices.
* Ability to interpret and develop technical drawings, schematics, wiring diagrams, and infrastructure layouts.
* Strong vendor management, stakeholder engagement, and contract management capabilities.
* Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities within fast\-paced, high\-pressure event environments.
* High attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence and delivery quality.

data.jd_text:
The
 **Airfield Driving Program Manager** 
 is responsible for planning, implementing, and overseeing the Airfield Driving Program (ADP) at Al Udeid Air Base. This role ensures the safe, compliant, and effective operation of vehicles and equipment on the airfield in accordance with U.S. Air Force, DoD, host\-nation, and installation\-specific regulations. The manager serves as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for airfield driving operations and provides leadership, training oversight, and compliance management for all authorized airfield drivers.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
* Lead and manage the installation Airfield Driving Program in accordance with applicable Air Force Instructions (AFIs), DoD directives, and local operating procedures.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all airfield driving matters.
* Develop, maintain, and enforce airfield driving policies, procedures, and standard operating instructions (SOIs).
* Oversee airfield driving training, testing, certification, and licensing processes for military, civilian, and contractor personnel.
* Coordinate closely with Airfield Management, Safety, Security Forces, Wing Safety, and host\-nation partners to ensure safe airfield operations.
* Conduct periodic program reviews, audits, and inspections to ensure compliance and identify risk mitigation measures.
* Investigate airfield driving incidents, violations, and mishaps; prepare reports and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records of driver qualifications, training, suspensions, revocations, and reinstatements.
* Advise leadership on airfield driving trends, hazards, and best practices.
* Supervise and mentor assigned staff or instructors supporting the Airfield Driving Program.
* Ensure compliance with force protection, safety, and operational risk management (ORM) principles.


**Education \& Experience**
* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience as a licensed airfield driver with no previous record or revocations.
* Strong knowledge of airfield layouts, markings, lighting, signage, and controlled movement areas.
* Proven ability to interpret and apply Air Force and DoD aviation regulations and guidance.


**Additional Requirements**
* Must possess a valid U.S. Driver’s License
* Possess a valid U.S. Passport (preferred)
* Must be able to meet all current USCENTCOM Deployment Policy Requirements, as outlined in the USCENTCOM APR 23 MOD EIGHTEEN TO USCENTCOM INDIVIDUAL AND INDIVIDUAL\-UNIT DEPLOYMENT POLICY
* Able to obtain and maintain a valid Residency Visa for Qatar
* Must be able to work in extreme environmental conditions including dust and high temperatures.
* Must be able to endure long hours, exposure to weather and hazardous conditions.


**TRAVEL:** 
 100%, in deployed location.
   

  

**SECURITY CLEARANCE:** 
 Must have and maintain a DoD Secret Clearance.

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 We are looking for a Deputy Director – Food Operations to fully own the operational performance of our Food vertical.
   

  

 This is a standalone, high\-impact role focused on execution, optimization, and profitability. You will work directly with the COO to translate strategy into disciplined operational outcomes. Food is a high\-frequency, high\-pressure business — it demands precision, speed, and strong judgment under constant movement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the operational engine of the Food vertical: vendor performance, delivery efficiency, cost structures, contribution margins, and overall vertical performance health. Every operational lever that impacts reliability, scalability, and profitability will sit under your direct ownership.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a performance role.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Operational Strategy \& Execution
* Partner closely with the COO to define and execute the Food operations roadmap.
* Convert strategic priorities into measurable KPIs and execution plans.
* Ensure sustainable order growth while protecting contribution margins and operational stability.
* Drive operational readiness for expansions, new initiatives, and structural improvements across the vertical.
* Food Vertical Performance \& Unit Economics
* Own the core performance metrics of the Food vertical including fulfillment rate, SLA adherence, cancellation rate, delivery time, cost per order, rider productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Continuously optimize supply\-demand balance in dense operating environments.
* Refine incentive structures for riders and restaurant partners with a clear understanding of their economic impact.
* Work closely with Finance to model profitability scenarios and implement cost control initiatives.
* You should deeply understand how prep time affects dispatch logic, how batching impacts utilization, and how operational mechanics influence margin.
* Process Optimization \& Scalability
* Identify inefficiencies across the Food operational lifecycle and eliminate them through structured, data\-driven problem solving. Standardize SOPs and improve operational consistency.
* Collaborate with Product and Tech to automate manual workflows and enhance dispatch, batching, and visibility tools.
* Lead root cause analysis for service failures and implement corrective action frameworks that prevent recurrence.
* Restaurant Operations \& Partner Success
* Monitor and improve restaurant operational metrics including prep time accuracy, acceptance rates, SLA compliance, and order quality.
* Work closely with Commercial to ensure operational feasibility during onboarding and scaling.
* Reduce friction between restaurants and logistics by introducing structured performance frameworks and clear accountability mechanisms.
* Analytics \& Performance Discipline
* Lead weekly and monthly performance reviews backed by data and actionable insights.
* Build and refine dashboards, reporting structures, and performance scorecards that directly influence operational decisions.
* Leverage demand forecasting, cohort analysis, and behavioural data to identify growth and efficiency levers. When metrics shift, you understand why — and you act decisively.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
* 10\+ years of operational experience, with at least 5–7 years in food delivery, high\-frequency platforms, or tech\-enabled logistics environments.
* Experience in dense, highly competitive markets is essential.
* Background in logistics, food operations, commercial strategy, or product operations within leading global platforms is strongly preferred. You must understand supply\-demand balance, incentive systems, batching logic, dispatch optimization, and unit economics at a structural level.
* Strong analytical capability is mandatory. Exposure to BI tools, SQL, and performance dashboarding is expected. MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.
* Beyond experience, we are looking for high cognitive ability, emotional resilience, and the ability to operate under sustained pressure. This role requires someone who takes ownership, makes tough decisions quickly, and executes without waiting for direction.

data.jd_text:
A leading regional bank is seeking a highly accomplished professional to spearhead the management of complex corporate restructuring and recovery mandates.
 



  





 This executive leadership role is responsible for managing and resolving stressed corporate exposures, developing recovery and restructuring strategies, preserving asset value, and maximizing recoveries across a diverse portfolio of corporate and commercial relationships.
 



 The successful candidate will work closely with senior management, business units, legal counsel, and external stakeholders to deliver effective turnaround, restructuring, and recovery solutions while ensuring sound risk management and regulatory compliance.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the Corporate Recovery \& Restructuring function and oversee the management of stressed and non\-performing corporate credit exposures.
* Develop and implement recovery, restructuring, and turnaround strategies for complex corporate relationships.
* Negotiate restructuring arrangements, settlements, and recovery plans with borrowers and other stakeholders.
* Assess business viability, cash flows, collateral positions, and recovery prospects to formulate optimal resolution strategies.
* Work closely with Corporate Banking, Credit Risk, Legal, and external advisors to manage problem accounts effectively.
* Oversee legal recovery actions, enforcement proceedings, and collateral realization where required.
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend proactive measures to mitigate potential losses.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
* Provide strategic insights and portfolio updates to Executive Management and relevant committees.
* Lead and develop a team of recovery and restructuring professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Law, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of banking experience, with significant exposure to Corporate Recovery, Restructuring, Special Assets, Credit Risk, or Workout functions.
* Proven track record in managing large and complex corporate restructuring and recovery cases.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance, credit analysis, restructuring frameworks, insolvency processes, and legal recovery mechanisms.
* Experience dealing with large corporate groups, family\-owned businesses, and syndicated lending arrangements.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical, and leadership capabilities.



  





**Key Competencies** 




  




* Strategic Thinking
* Corporate Restructuring \& Turnaround Management
* Credit Risk Management
* Stakeholder Negotiation
* Portfolio Management
* Regulatory \& Governance Compliance
* Leadership \& Team Development

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Vice President of Asset Management Strategy is a senior leadership role responsible for defining and driving the strategic direction of the QNB's asset management operations. This role involves developing and implementing strategic initiatives to enhance portfolio performance, optimize asset allocation, and align investment strategies with the QNB's long\-term goals. The VP will work closely with senior management to ensure the effective execution of asset management strategies and drive organizational growth.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute comprehensive asset management strategies that align with the QNB’s overall objectives and market opportunities.
* Analyze market trends, investment opportunities, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic planning.
* Oversee the optimization of asset allocation across various investment portfolios to maximize returns and manage risk.
* Implement strategies to enhance portfolio performance and adjust investment approaches based on market conditions and performance metrics.
* Develop and implement best practices for asset management operations to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and profitability.
* Ensure integration of strategic initiatives with operational processes and systems.
* Collaborate with senior executives, investment managers, and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment and effective execution of asset management strategies.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional investors, clients, and industry professionals to support business development and client satisfaction.
* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of asset management strategies.
* Provide regular updates and reports to senior management and stakeholders on strategy execution, performance outcomes, and strategic initiatives.
* Lead and mentor a team of asset management professionals, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and high performance.
* Oversee recruitment, development, and performance evaluation of team members.
* Identify and manage risks associated with asset management strategies and operations.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry standards.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Minimum of 10 \-15 years of experience in asset management, with a strong background in strategic planning and portfolio management.
* Proven track record in developing and executing asset management strategies and driving organizational growth.
* Extensive experience working with senior management and stakeholders to align and execute strategic initiatives.
* Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to develop and implement effective asset management strategies.
* Excellent leadership and management abilities, with experience in leading and developing high\-performing teams.
* Superior communication and interpersonal skills, with the capability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
* Professional certification CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst (Level 3\) is required.
* Have experience in US Equity is required, and China Equity is a plus.
* 5 Years of proven track record managing stocks.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and continuous improvement of all engineering functions within the hotel. This role oversees the maintenance and reliability of the property's physical assets, including building infrastructure, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems, HVAC, fire and life safety systems, energy management systems, and all back\-of\-house facilities.
 



  





 The incumbent ensures that all engineering operations support the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and financial performance. The Director of Engineering develops long\-term asset management strategies, leads capital improvement initiatives, and drives preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and lifecycle value.
 



  





 As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Engineering collaborates closely with hotel leadership to align engineering objectives with overall business goals and serves as the lead coordinator for emergency preparedness and response activities related to facility operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Operations \& Technical Leadership** 




  




* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all engineering and maintenance operations across the property.
* Direct the operation, maintenance, and optimization of HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, refrigeration systems, electrical distribution networks, generators, UPS systems, plumbing infrastructure, water treatment systems, swimming pool systems, kitchen and laundry equipment, elevators, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
* Establish and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure optimal equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor engineering performance indicators, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturer recommendations.



  





**Asset Management \& Capital Planning** 




  




* Develop and execute long\-term engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual Engineering Business Plan and departmental objectives.
* Prepare, justify, and manage the annual engineering operating budget and capital expenditure plans.
* Develop and maintain a 5 to 10\-year asset replacement strategy for major plant and equipment.
* Manage renovation projects, equipment upgrades, and capital improvement initiatives from planning through commissioning.
* Supervise contractors, consultants, and project teams to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications.



  





**Financial Management** 




  




* Monitor departmental expenditures and maintain effective control over engineering operating costs.
* Analyze financial reports, payroll summaries, utility consumption trends, and P\&L statements to identify areas for optimization.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives related to energy consumption, maintenance practices, procurement strategies, and service agreements.
* Ensure effective inventory management and control of engineering tools, spare parts, and consumables.
* Contribute to the annual budgeting and forecasting process.



  





**Energy \& Sustainability Management** 




  




* Lead energy conservation initiatives aimed at reducing utility consumption while maintaining guest comfort and operational efficiency.
* Monitor and optimize electricity, water, gas, and fuel usage through data\-driven analysis and system enhancements.
* Promote sustainable engineering practices and support environmental initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational performance and reduce environmental impact.



  





**Fire, Life Safety \& Regulatory Compliance** 




  




* Ensure full compliance with all applicable local regulations, Qatar Civil Defence requirements, health and safety standards, environmental regulations, and hotel brand standards.
* Maintain the operational readiness of all fire detection, fire suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation, and life safety systems.
* Oversee the testing, inspection, certification, and maintenance of all statutory systems and equipment.
* Ensure all permits, licenses, certifications, and maintenance records remain current and readily available for audit purposes.
* Serve as the Chairperson of the Emergency Response Team and lead preparedness planning for facility\-related emergencies.



  





**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 




  




* Lead, mentor, and develop the engineering management team and technical staff to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a safe working environment through effective implementation of health and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, labor regulations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Encourage employee engagement through open communication, recognition programs, and succession planning initiatives.



  





**Guest Experience \& Service Excellence** 




  




* Support hotel operations by ensuring all guest\-facing facilities remain in excellent working condition.
* Respond proactively to engineering\-related guest concerns and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with operational departments to minimize disruption during maintenance activities.
* Drive initiatives that enhance comfort, reliability, and overall guest satisfaction through engineering excellence.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, facilities management, energy management, or project management will be considered an advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive engineering experience within luxury hospitality environments, including at least 3–5 years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale hotel engineering operations, preferably within internationally recognized five\-star hotels or resorts.
* Demonstrated expertise in preventive maintenance programs, asset lifecycle management, and capital project execution.
* Experience managing engineering budgets, utility optimization programs, and vendor relationships.



  





**Technical Competencies** 




  




* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration plants, electrical distribution systems, plumbing systems, water treatment processes, fire and life safety systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS).
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
* Thorough understanding of Qatar Civil Defence regulations, local statutory requirements, and international hospitality engineering standards.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical manuals, and financial reports.



  





**Leadership Competencies** 




  




* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Commitment to service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational integrity

data.jd_text:
Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
 



  





**About Shifamed** 




 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
 



  





 Description:
 



 This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and management of quality systems and practices. This position will oversee and ensure that the development, manufacture, testing and release of products are performed according to the applicable federal and state regulations, international standards, and the Company’s Quality Policy.
 



  





 Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:
 


* Ensure compliance with applicable Quality System Regulations and standards, including FDA QSR, ISO 13485, MDR, GMP, and Design Controls.
* Partner with R\&D and Operations to establish and maintain quality requirements throughout product development, transfer, manufacturing, and post\-market activities.
* Lead and maintain Design History Files (DHF), Risk Management Files, and associated quality documentation for products and processes.
* Develop and implement quality engineering activities including design verification/validation, process validation, equipment qualification, test method validation, and first article inspections.
* Support manufacturing quality activities including inspection processes, nonconformance investigations, CAPA, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee manufacturing and quality documentation including procedures, inspection instructions, Lot History Records, and Bills of Materials.
* Manage supplier quality activities including supplier qualification, audits, source inspections, supplier controls, and ongoing quality performance monitoring.
* Prepare for, host, and support internal, customer, supplier, and regulatory audits and inspections.
* Coordinate quality system training and promote company\-wide quality system awareness and compliance.
* Support complaint handling, MDR/vigilance reporting, field actions, and investigation of product or process failures.
* Serve as Quality representative on cross\-functional project teams and act as site Management Representative and/or Quality signature authority as required.
* Lead and manage Quality Assurance resources to ensure effective execution of quality system and regulatory compliance activities.
* Other duties as assigned.



  





 Education \& Work Experience:
 


* Bachelors or Masters in Engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience
* 15\+ years of Quality or Technical Management experience in the medical device industry or a related field.
* Previous direct people management experience.
* Previous experience bringing a company into regulatory compliance and approval, preferred.
* Solid knowledge of FDA regulations and interpretation of FDA regulations, guidelines, and policy statements.
* Solid knowledge of international regulations, standards, and guidelines (i.e. MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601 and collateral standards, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, FDA guidance documents for cybersecurity).
* Ability to train others in processes and procedures.
* Excellent communications skills (both written and verbal) required.
* Ability to work effectively across functional lines to reach effective outcomes for the business.
* Ability to travel as required.



  





 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
 



  





 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.
